      docs/log.md:433:Added `modules/bird_detection.py` (YOLO `BirdDetector` + pure `select_best_box`) wired into `BioCLIPClassifier.classify` — detects the bird, crops to the highest-confidence box before BioCLIP species classification, falls back to whole image. New `images.bird_bbox` JSONB column (migration `0033`, `db_postgres` DDL, `db.update_image_bird_bbox`), `bird_detection` config section, optional `ultralytics`/`huggingface_hub` deps. Tests: `tests/test_bird_detection.py`.
      docs/log.md:445:Added [`docs/reports/BIRD_BBOX_CROP_STUDY_2026-08-01.md`](reports/BIRD_BBOX_CROP_STUDY_2026-08-01.md) — close-out for [#317](https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/317). The first sweep produced four mutually incomparable populations (strided sampling of a `bird_bbox` set that a backfill was growing mid-run); those 38 NPZs stay quarantined in `npz/archive_mixed_population/`. Re-ran phases 1/2/2b/3 against a pinned 236-image population bound to the human label set, with `pin_study_set --verify` as a gate (100 NPZs, one id set, 0 mismatched). Verdicts: crop is a complementary signal for IQA (2.42×–17.51× subject-degradation sensitivity), captions (+0.105 within-burst uniqueness) and small-subject species (+0.053 agreement), and **no benefit** for culling embeddings (+0.0028 burst pair-margin). No accuracy claims — the 236 human verdicts are still unfilled. Registered in `docs/reports/INDEX.md`.
      docs/log.md:461:Closed out the bird-crop / focus workstream ([#317](https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/317)). **Track A completed** — all 7 models on the pinned 236-image population, merges clean (`Carried forward 6 previously measured model(s)`, no `replacing it rather than merging`). On *constructed* degradation the classical measures top the study: `dog_energy` **8.80×** and `haar_energy` **7.20×** crop sensitivity to subject-only blur, above LIQE's 3.61× — but on the noise ladder three of four are flagged **Suspect**, `laplacian_variance` scoring ρ **+0.996** as sharpness rises with grain. **Arm B was scored for the first time and fails**: precision **0.1429** against a base reject rate of **0.2963** — lift **×0.48**, recall **0.0156**, TP 1 / FP 6 / FN 63 — on the agent-derived label set, i.e. worse than the base rate, consistent with Arm A's at-chance AUC 0.5295 against real misfocus. Updated [`docs/reports/BIRD_CROP_FOCUS_MEASURES_2026-08-03.md`](reports/BIRD_CROP_FOCUS_MEASURES_2026-08-03.md) (headline, Arm B, and a Track A section replacing “Still in flight”), and appended dated resolution sections to [`RESEARCH_SESSIONS_2026-08-05.md`](reports/RESEARCH_SESSIONS_2026-08-05.md) and both `SESSION_BIRD_CROP_*_2026-08-05.md` records rather than rewriting their pause snapshots. Added a `focus_arm_b_rule` CSV/TSV exporter carrying `ground_truth_kind`, so an agent-derived precision cannot be quoted as if it were human-validated. Production untouched: `technical_failures.enabled` stays `false`, no DDL, no migration.
      docs/log.md:465:Updated [`docs/technical/BIRD_SPECIES_WALKTHROUGH.md`](technical/BIRD_SPECIES_WALKTHROUGH.md) for [#338](https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/338). `images.bird_bbox` used to be written only as a side effect of BioCLIP classification and was invisible to every completeness check, so a species-complete (or exhausted) image with no box could only be repaired by `scripts/backfill_bird_bbox.py`. `get_phase_incomplete_sql("bird_species")` and `is_image_bird_species_complete` now also count a `NULL` box, or one holding a retryable sentinel (`RETRYABLE_BBOX_ERRORS` = `detector_unavailable`), as phase work — so such folders surface as `awaiting_bird_species` and **Dashboard → Drive to Complete** repairs them unattended. `BirdSpeciesRunner` gained a detector-only pass (`scan_bird_bbox_only`) that writes `bird_bbox` and nothing else: no BioCLIP load, no keyword or embedding writes, no phase-status change. The folder rollup (`get_folder_phase_summary`) excludes a box-gap image from both `done_count` and `skipped_count`, which is what actually moves the Dashboard bucket to `awaiting_bird_species`, and `update_image_bird_bbox` now invalidates the folder aggregate cache so the bucket flips back once repaired. Data-terminal sentinels (`decode_error`, `file_missing`, …) stay non-retryable so the drive converges. Added the *Box gap* row to the §3.2.1 eligibility table. No schema change, no frontend change, `BIRD_SPECIES_RUNNER_VERSION` deliberately not bumped.

styling into a unified system (CSS Modules or Tailwind)"},{"assignees":["synthet"],"content":{"body":"The embedding atlas page hardcodes the embedding space:\n\n```ts\n// frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/pages/EmbeddingAtlasPage.tsx:32-35\nconst [params, setParams] = useState<FetchEmbeddingMapParams>({\n  space_code: 'mobilenet_v2_imagenet_gap',\n  method: 'umap',\n});\n```\n\n`ProjectionSettingsDialog.tsx` ships a static option list of 4 codes. The backend already exposes `GET /api/embedding_spaces` (registry of active spaces) ΓÇö the SPA should fetch it and let users switch between MobileNet, CLIP, BLIP, BioCLIP without code changes when new spaces register.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] New `useEmbeddingSpaces` hook (TanStack Query) wraps `/api/embedding_spaces`.\n- [ ] `ProjectionSettingsDialog` populates the Embedding Space select from the hook (not hardcoded).\n- [ ] Default space falls back to `mobilenet_v2_imagenet_gap` if the registry is empty.\n- [ ] Changing the space invalidates the embedding-map cache and triggers a refetch (or uses `refresh=true`).\n- [ ] Unknown / inactive space is skipped gracefully (already handled by `meta.error: unknown_embedding_space`).\n\n## References\n- `modules/api.py` ΓÇö `/api/embedding_spaces` endpoint\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/components/ProjectionSettingsDialog.tsx` ΓÇö current static list\n- `docs/plans/database/DB_VECTORS_REFACTOR.md` ΓÇö registry table semantics","number":133,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Atlas: replace hardcoded space_code with /api/embedding_spaces dropdown","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/133"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgrm8n0","labels":["enhancement","area:gradio","priority:p1","type:feature"],"linked pull requests":["https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/pull/178"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Review","status":"Done","title":"Atlas: replace hardcoded space_code with /api/embedding_spaces dropdown"},{"content":{"body":"The shell sidebar already renders a `ScopeSelector`, but `EmbeddingAtlasPage` never reads its current folder into `params`. Result: picking a folder in the global scope sidebar has no effect on the atlas projection ΓÇö it always renders all embedded images.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] `EmbeddingAtlasPage` subscribes to the global scope store (whatever `ScopeSelector` writes to).\n- [ ] When the scope folder changes, `params.folder_path` updates and `useEmbeddingMap` refetches.\n- [ ] Empty scope ΓåÆ no filter (current behavior).\n- [ ] Verify visually: pick `mnt/d/Photos/Z6ii/180-600mm` and the cloud shrinks to that folder's points.\n\n## References\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/pages/EmbeddingAtlasPage.tsx`\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/hooks/useEmbeddingMap.ts:36` ΓÇö `folder_path?: string` already in params\n- `frontend/src/components/scope/ScopeSelector.tsx` (find current scope source of truth)","number":134,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Atlas: wire global ScopeSelector folder to embedding_map folder_path","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/134"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgrm8n8","labels":["area:gradio","priority:p1","type:feature"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Ready","status":"Todo","title":"Atlas: wire global ScopeSelector folder to embedding_map folder_path"},{"content":{"body":"The plan calls for a round-trip: from `ImageInspectorPage`, a \"Show on embedding map\" link that opens `/ui/embeddings?focus=<image_id>` and recenters the canvas on that point. Today neither side is wired.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] `ImageInspectorPage` (or `ImageInspectorSheet`) renders a \"Show on embedding map\" link/button to `/ui/embeddings?focus=<image_id>`.\n- [ ] `EmbeddingAtlasPage` reads `searchParams.focus`, calls Cosmograph's ref API to `zoomToPoints` / `focusPoint` for that id once data loads.\n- [ ] Selection store updates so the side filmstrip pre-loads similar images.\n- [ ] If the focused id is missing from the current projection (e.g. wrong scope/space), surface an inline message rather than failing silently.\n\n## References\n- `frontend/src/pages/ImageInspectorPage.tsx`\n- `@cosmograph/react` ΓÇö `Cosmograph` ref methods (`zoomToPoints`, `focusPoint`, `selectPoint`)\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/pages/EmbeddingAtlasPage.tsx`","number":135,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Atlas: cross-link inspector to atlas via ?focus=<image_id>","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/135"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgrm8pM","labels":["area:gradio","priority:p2","type:feature"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Ready","status":"Todo","title":"Atlas: cross-link inspector to atlas via ?focus=<image_id>"},{"content":{"body":"`EmbeddingCanvas.tsx` wires `pointColorByFn` / `pointSizeByFn` against `pointColorBy=\"image_id\"` / `pointSizeBy=\"image_id\"` and ignores the `_value` arg, re-indexing into a closed-over `nodes[]` array via `(value, index) => nodes[index]`. This works only because Cosmograph's internal table happens to be in the same order as our memo. Three concrete fragility points:\n\n1. **Index-coupling** ΓÇö if Cosmograph ever filters/reorders rows internally (it has crossfilter / data-manager paths that do), color/size silently mis-align with rows.\n2. **Auto-resolved color strategy** ΓÇö `pointColorBy: 'image_id'` is numeric, so `resolveOptimalPointColorStrategy` may choose `Continuous` and build a quantile scale that is then overridden by `Fn`. Pinning the strategy is safer.\n3. **`pointIncludeColumns: ['*']`** ΓÇö defeats the allowlist; ships every row column to DuckDB. We only read `image_id`, `file_path`, `thumbnail_path`, `score_*`.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] Compute color hex per point in the `nodes` memo and store on the row (e.g. `__color`); use `pointColorBy: '__color'` + `pointColorStrategy: 'palette'` (or whichever Cosmograph strategy passes the column value through unchanged).\n- [ ] Same treatment for size: `__size` numeric column + `pointSizeBy: '__size'`.\n- [ ] Replace `pointIncludeColumns: ['*']` with an explicit list of columns the UI reads.\n- [ ] Verify color/size still react to `activeColorMode` and `selectedPointId` / `hoveredPointId` changes (recompute the columns on those deps).\n- [ ] Manual smoke: hover/select a point and confirm the right dot grows; switch Color By and confirm the cloud recolors.\n\n## References\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/components/EmbeddingCanvas.tsx`\n- `frontend/node_modules/@cosmograph/cosmograph/cosmograph/strategies/point-color.js` ΓÇö resolution rules\n- `frontend/node_modules/@cosmograph/cosmograph/cosmograph/config/interfaces/data.d.ts` ΓÇö `BasePointsConfigKeys`","number":136,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Atlas: refactor Cosmograph color/size to use real columns + strategy (drop closure-by-index)","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/136"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgrm8q8","labels":["area:gradio","priority:p2","type:refactor"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Ready","status":"Todo","title":"Atlas: refactor Cosmograph color/size to use real columns + strategy (drop closure-by-index)"},{"content":{"body":"Two related visual issues in the atlas color modes.\n\n## 1. 5-bucket score ramp loses signal at the top\n`colorFromUnitScore` in `EmbeddingCanvas.tsx` quantizes `[0,1]` into 5 fixed bins (red, orange, amber, lime, green). Photo-library scores cluster in 0.4ΓÇô0.8, so most of the cloud reads as amber/lime ΓÇö most of the gradient is wasted on the tails.\n\n```ts\n// EmbeddingCanvas.tsx:8-15\nconst SCORE_UNIT_GRADIENT = ['#ef4444', '#f97316', '#eab308', '#84cc16', '#22c55e'] as const;\nfunction colorFromUnitScore(v: number | null | undefined): string {\n  if (v == null || !Number.isFinite(v)) return '#64748b';\n  const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));\n  const bin = Math.min(4, Math.floor(x * 5));\n  return SCORE_UNIT_GRADIENT[bin]!;\n}\n```\n\n**Fix:** interpolate continuously between two/three anchor hues (e.g. red ΓåÆ yellow ΓåÆ green via HSL lerp, then convert to hex). Or bump to 7ΓÇô9 bins. Continuous is preferable for visual gradient.\n\n## 2. Folder palette shadows the missing-data color\n`folderColor.ts` includes `#64748b` (slate) at index 17 of `FOLDER_PALETTE`. That's the same shade `colorFromUnitScore` returns for missing scores and `colorForIndex` returns for unknown nodes. A folder that hashes to bin 17 is visually indistinguishable from \"no data\".\n\n**Fix:** drop `#64748b` from `FOLDER_PALETTE` (or replace with a different accent). Reserve slate exclusively for \"missing/unknown\" everywhere.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] Score modes (general / aesthetic / technical / iq_*) use a continuous 0ΓÇô1 hex interpolation, not 5 bins.\n- [ ] `FOLDER_PALETTE` no longer contains `#64748b`.\n- [ ] Manual: switch Color By ΓåÆ Aesthetic Score, eyeball that mid-range scores show a discernible gradient, not just two tones.\n- [ ] Manual: in Folder mode, no real folder is colored slate; only missing-path / no-data points show slate.\n\n## References\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/components/EmbeddingCanvas.tsx:8-15`\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/utils/folderColor.ts:22-41`","number":137,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Atlas: continuous score color ramp + remove slate from folder palette","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/137"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgrm8sM","labels":["area:gradio","priority:p2","type:bug"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Ready","status":"Todo","title":"Atlas: continuous score color ramp + remove slate from folder palette"},{"content":{"body":"`onPointMouseOut` immediately calls `setHoveredPointId(null)`, which unmounts `ImageHoverCard`. If a user wants to traverse from the dot to the card (to read the full filename or copy text), the card vanishes mid-move.\n\nThe card is `pointer-events-none` so it can't be hovered directly anyway, but a small debounce makes the read-on-hover experience less twitchy.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] `setHoveredPointId(null)` is debounced ~150 ms in `EmbeddingCanvas`'s `onPointMouseOut`.\n- [ ] Mousing onto another point cancels the pending null and sets the new id immediately.\n- [ ] Tooltip stays visible if the user briefly leaves the dot's pixel without entering another.\n\n## References\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/components/EmbeddingCanvas.tsx:148`\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/components/ImageHoverCard.tsx`","number":138,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Atlas: debounce hover card unmount on mouseout","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/138"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgrm8so","labels":["area:gradio","priority:p3","type:feature"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Ready","status":"Todo","title":"Atlas: debounce hover card unmount on mouseout"},{"content":{"body":"`fitViewOnInit` only fires once. When the user opens/closes the inspector or filmstrip, or drags the panel separator, the canvas keeps the old fit and the cloud sits off-center. Cosmograph exposes `fitView()` on the ref.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] Capture a `Cosmograph` ref via `forwardRef` / `onMount`.\n- [ ] Observe canvas-container size (e.g. ResizeObserver) and call `cosmograph.fitView()` after a debounced settle (~250 ms).\n- [ ] Don't fit while the user is actively zooming/panning.\n\n## References\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/components/EmbeddingCanvas.tsx`\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/pages/EmbeddingAtlasPage.tsx` ΓÇö collapsible panels via `panelRef`\n- `@cosmograph/react` `Cosmograph` component `onMount(cosmograph)` exposes the instance","number":139,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Atlas: refit Cosmograph view when panels resize","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/139"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgrm8s4","labels":["area:gradio","priority:p3","type:feature"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Ready","status":"Todo","title":"Atlas: refit Cosmograph view when panels resize"},{"content":{"body":"The toolbar exposes a Lasso button but it's currently disabled (`title=\"Lasso selection is not available yet\"`). Cosmograph supports polygonal area selection out of the box.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] Enable the Lasso button when `currentTool === 'lasso'`.\n- [ ] Wire `onPolygonSelected(points)` callback on `<Cosmograph>` to receive the selection.\n- [ ] Selected point indices land in the store (e.g. `setSelectedClusterIds` already exists).\n- [ ] Filmstrip / inspector reflect the multi-select (or define a clear UX: count + \"open first\" link).\n- [ ] Esc clears the lasso.\n\n## References\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/components/EmbeddingToolbar.tsx:44-52`\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/stores/embeddingAtlasStore.ts` ΓÇö `currentTool`, `selectedClusterIds`\n- `@cosmograph/react` props: `onPolygonSelected`, `polygonalSelectorStrokeColor`","number":140,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Atlas: implement lasso selection (Cosmograph polygonal select)","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/140"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgrm8tc","labels":["area:gradio","priority:p3","type:feature"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Ready","status":"Todo","title":"Atlas: implement lasso selection (Cosmograph polygonal select)"},{"content":{"body":"Every time we add a per-point score to the `/api/embedding_map` payload (`score_technical`, `score_aesthetic`, IQ-model columns), `_make_cache_key` bumps `output_v` and invalidates every cached projection on disk. At 50k points ├ù multiple spaces that's not free to recompute.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] Decide on one of two strategies:\n  - **(a) Generic blob.** Replace per-column score fields on the cache payload with `scores: Record<string, number | null>`. Reading the payload tolerates new keys without bumping `output_v`. Frontend reads `point.scores?.technical` etc.\n  - **(b) Soft-merge.** Keep current shape but make the read side tolerate missing columns silently (already partially the case ΓÇö color falls back to slate). Document the compatibility contract.\n- [ ] Pick (a) or (b), implement, ship.\n- [ ] Add a unit test that asserts adding a new score column does not require an `output_v` bump.\n- [ ] Update `compute_embedding_map`, `get_embeddings_with_metadata`, `get_embeddings_with_metadata_for_space`, `tests/test_api_embedding_map.py`.\n\n## References\n- `modules/projections.py` ΓÇö `_make_cache_key`, `compute_embedding_map`\n- `modules/db_legacy.py` ΓÇö `get_embeddings_with_metadata`\n- `modules/projections_db.py` ΓÇö `get_embeddings_with_metadata_for_space`\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/hooks/useEmbeddingMap.ts:4-20` ΓÇö `EmbeddingPoint`","number":141,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Atlas: forward-compatible projection cache to slow output_v churn","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/141"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgrm8t0","labels":["area:python","priority:p3","type:refactor"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Ready","status":"Todo","title":"Atlas: forward-compatible projection cache to slow output_v churn"},{"content":{"body":"`setSelectedPointId(null)` currently also flips `sidePanelOpen: false`:\n\n```ts\n// embeddingAtlasStore.ts:42-46\nsetSelectedPointId: (id) =>\n  set({\n    selectedPointId: id,\n    ...(id == null ? { sidePanelOpen: false } : {}),\n  }),\n```\n\nPossible footgun: toolbar \"Inspector\" toggle calls `setSidePanelOpen(true)` while `selectedPointId` is `null`. The inspector opens, but if the user then deselects a point (or any path that fires `setSelectedPointId(null)`), the inspector closes unexpectedly.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] Either (a) the inspector lifecycle is fully driven by `sidePanelOpen` (selection clear no longer touches it), or (b) the inspector requires `selectedPointId` to render and the close is explicit.\n- [ ] Decide and document the rule in a comment on the store.\n- [ ] Manual test: select point ΓåÆ open inspector ΓåÆ click empty canvas (deselect) ΓåÆ inspector should follow the documented rule, not behave randomly.\n\n## References\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/stores/embeddingAtlasStore.ts:42-46`\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/components/ImageInspectorSheet.tsx:7-16`\n- `frontend/src/features/embedding-atlas/components/EmbeddingToolbar.tsx` ΓÇö Inspector toggle","number":142,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Atlas: decouple setSelectedPointId(null) from inspector close","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/142"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgrm8uE","labels":["area:gradio","priority:p3","type:bug"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Ready","status":"Todo","title":"Atlas: decouple setSelectedPointId(null) from inspector close"},{"assignees":["synthet"],"content":{"body":"## Summary\n\nIncremental subsystem for **technical-defect signals** (classical-first MVP), persisted in PostgreSQL with API exposure on existing image-detail payloads. Integrate inside the existing **`scoring`** phase after `MultiModelHost.run_all_models()` ΓÇö **no new pipeline phase**; must not break RAW/NEF handling (run detector on same preprocessed path models use).\n\n**Planning:** Design notes in Cursor plan `technical_failure_detection_b73e53c6.plan.md`; add canonical `docs/planning/models/TECHNICAL_FAILURE_DETECTION_PLAN.md` as part of delivery.\n\n## Specification alignment\n\n- Example JSON nests metrics under **`technical_failures`**; **`primary_reject_reason`** must include **`none`** plus **every scalar key inside `technical_failures`** (e.g. include highlight_clipping, shadow_crushing, overexposed, underexposed as needed). Document ordering / tie-break policy in planning doc.\n- **`technical_failure_score`** (0ΓÇô100) = calibrated aggregate; MVP: simple weighted or max-of-failure with formula documented.\n\n## MVP scope\n\n1. Package **`modules/technical_failures/`**: `schemas.py`, `classical_metrics.py` (numpy; OpenCV only if already standard ΓÇö avoid new heavy deps on CPU-only installs), `detector.py`, `calibration.py` stubs; **`detect_technical_failures(path, context) -> TechnicalFailurePayload`**.\n2. **`ScoringWorker.process`**: after successful `run_all_models()`, run detector on job image path (guarded by `technical_failures.enabled`). Try/except with **`fail_on_detector_error`** config (default false).\n3. **`image_technical_failures`** table (Approach A): Alembic + mirror `CREATE TABLE` in `db_postgres.py` bootstrap; **`upsert_image_technical_failures`** from `upsert_image` (pattern like `_write_image_model_scores`). FK `images(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`.\n4. Merge structured output into scorer results / **`scores_json`** summary (e.g. `summary[\"technical_failure_detection\"]`).\n5. **`GET /api/images/{id}`** (and public route): **`technical_failure_detection`** object via join or secondary query in `_image_detail_payload`. Update OpenAPI + **`docs/technical/API_CONTRACT.md`**.\n6. **`config.example.json`** section `technical_failures` (`enabled`, `use_classical_metrics`, `use_clip_iqa`, `use_pyiqa`, `fail_on_detector_error`, `version`).\n7. Docs: touch **`docs/IMAGE_PIPELINE.md`**, **`docs/technical/SCORING_CHANGES.md`**, append **`docs/log.md`** per wiki rules.\n\n## Explicit non-goals (MVP)\n\nNew phase; new git LFS weights; subject-aware sharpness; bird detectors; calibrated CLIP prompts; training datasets; pyiqa/CLIP-IQA (separate tickets).\n\n## Tests\n\n- `tests/test_technical_failures_*.py`: classical metrics on synthetic arrays; schema/aggregation; ImportError monkeypatch for optional ML branch if stubbed.\n- Fast gate: `python -m pytest -m \"not gpu and not db and not ml and not firebird\" --ignore=tests/test_probe.py`\n- DB/API tests per existing markers (`db` / mocked).\n\n## Commit sequence (Deliverable B)\n\n1. Classical metrics + synthetic tests  \n2. Schemas + detector + degradation  \n3. Alembic + postgres DDL + db_legacy upsert  \n4. ScoringWorker integration + summary merge  \n5. API + OpenAPI + API_CONTRACT  \n6. full stack (captions + vector persistence) per model family.\n\n**Depends on:** spike + migration + factory issues where applicable.","number":153,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"[#118] VL models: BLIP-2 / LLaVA / InternVL backends","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/153"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgrsKnM","labels":["area:python","priority:p2","type:feature"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Ready","status":"Todo","title":"[#118] VL models: BLIP-2 / LLaVA / InternVL backends"},{"content":{"body":"Sub-task of [#118](https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/118).\n\nUpdate OpenAPI wording (not BLIP-only), Gradio tagging settings (caption backend + model), `config.example.json`, and `docs/technical/EMBEDDINGS.md` registry table for new spaces.","number":154,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"[#118] VL models: API, Gradio settings, config + docs","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/154"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgrsKno","labels":["area:python","priority:p2","type:feature"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Ready","status":"Todo","title":"[#118] VL models: API, Gradio settings, config + docs"},{"content":{"body":"Sub-task of [#118](https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/118).\n\nUnit tests for caption-backend factory/config wiring; Postgres integration test for new embedding space write path (pattern from `tests/test_postgres_integration.py`). Keep heavy model loads behind `ml`/`gpu` markers as appropriate.","number":155,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"[#118] VL models: tests (factory + Postgres integration)","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/155"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgrsKoA","labels":["area:python","priority:p2","type:feature"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Ready","status":"Todo","title":"[#118] VL models: tests (factory + Postgres integration)"},{"assignees":["synthet"],"content":{"body":"## Symptom\n\nIn the React Runs UI (`/ui/runs/:id`), the **work-items** progress bar for the active phase shows `0 / 0 work items (0%)` for the entire duration of the phase, even when work is happening. The denominator finally appears (and `processed` snaps to the final value) only when the phase transitions to `completed`.\n\n## Reproduction\n\nObserved on run 2365 (2026-05-10) during the metadata phase. Live DB cross-check while UI showed `0 / 0`:\n\n```\n-- job_phases counters (what the UI reads)\nphase_order=0 metadata running in_scope=0 processed=0 skipped=0 failed=0\n\n-- IPS rows for the same 733 ids (what's actually happening)\nphase_id=2 (metadata): 86 done, 1 running   -- earlier in the phase\nphase_id=2 (metadata): 600 done, 1 running  -- mid-phase\nphase_id=2 (metadata): 631 done, 1 running  -- later\nphase_id=2 (metadata): 733 done             -- only after phase flipped to completed\n                                                does job_phases show in_scope=733 processed=733\n```\n\nSo real progress was visible in `image_phase_status` while `job_phases` stayed at 0.\n\n## Root cause\n\n`ReportCollector.finalize()` is the only place that calls `db.update_job_phase_counters(...)`:\n\n```python\n# modules/report_collector.py (~269-285)\ntry:\n    from modules import db\n    db.update_job_phase_counters(\n        self.job_id, self.phase_code,\n        in_scope=self._images_in_scope,\n        targeted=self._images_targeted,\n        processed=self._processed,\n        skipped=self._skipped,\n        failed=self._failed,\n    )\nexcept Exception:\n    logger.exception(\"ReportCollector: failed to update job_phases counters ΓÇª\")\n```\n\nThe collector receives `set_scope_counts(in_scope, targeted)` at phase start and increments `_processed`/`_skipped`/`_failed` per image, but never pushes anything to `job_phases` until `finalize()` runs. The Runs UI faithfully reads what's there: zeros.\n\n## Proposed fix\n\nTwo small changes in `modules/report_collector.py`:\n\n1. **At phase start:** in `set_scope_counts(...)`, immediately call `db.update_job_phase_counters(job_id, phase_code, in_scope=in_scope, targeted=targeted, processed=0, skipped=0, failed=0)`. This makes the denominator visible the moment the runner knows scope.\n2. **During the run:** piggyback on the existing `_FLUSH_THRESHOLD` path in `_flush_unlocked` (or add a similar threshold), so every N processed images we also flush counters. Keep it cheap ΓÇö one UPDATE per flush batch.\n\nCaveats:\n- `update_job_phase_counters` currently overwrites all five counters in one statement. The during-run flush should pass the current totals (already tracked in `self._processed` etc.), so this is safe.\n- If `finalize()` later overwrites with the final values, that's fine ΓÇö same statement, same row.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- For a running phase, `job_phases.images_in_scope` is non-zero within seconds of the phase starting.\n- `images_processed`/`skipped`/`failed` update at least every ~N images (matching `_FLUSH_THRESHOLD` cadence ΓÇö currently 25 by default in the collector).\n- Runs UI work-items panel shows non-zero denominator and a moving bar throughout an active phase.\n- No regressions: `finalize()` still writes the final totals.\n\n## Severity\n\n**p2** ΓÇö cosmetic but high-visibility. Users reasonably interpret `0 / 0` as \"the runner didn't pick this up\" (see #156, where this masked a real scoring bug).","number":158,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"job_phases counters not flushed during run ΓÇö Runs UI shows 0/0 for entire active phase","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/158"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgssCwI","labels":["bug","area:python","area:gradio","priority:p2","type:bug"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Review","status":"Done","title":"job_phases counters not flushed during run ΓÇö Runs UI shows 0/0 for entire active phase"},{"content":{"body":"## Symptom\n\nWhen a pipeline job is submitted with an explicit `image_ids` list and `operations: [\"score\"]` (or a chain that includes `score`), the scoring phase runs for ~3 seconds, marks itself **`completed`** with `images_in_scope = 0, images_processed = 0`, and produces no `image_phase_status` rows for `scoring`. The target images stay with `score_general IS NULL`.\n\nObserved end-to-end on **run 2365** (2026-05-10) ΓÇö a gallery sync of 733 NEFs.\n\n## Reproduction\n\nRun 2365 queue_payload (truncated):\n```\n{\n  \"input_path\": \"D:\\Photos\\Z8\\180-600mm\\2026\\2026-05-10\",\n  \"stage_codes\": [\"metadata\", \"score\", \"tag\", \"cluster\"],\n  \"skip_existing\": true,\n  \"resolved_image_ids\": [167287, ..., 168029],   // 733 ids\n  \"selector_preview_count\": 733\n}\n```\n\n`job_phases` after run finished:\n```\nphase_order=0 metadata   completed  in_scope=733 processed=733\nphase_order=1 scoring    completed  in_scope=0   processed=0\nphase_order=2 keywords   completed  in_scope=0   processed=0   (worked anyway via tagging runner)\nphase_order=3 culling    completed  in_scope=0   processed=0\n```\n\nAfter run 2365 completed:\n```\nSELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE score_general IS NOT NULL) AS with_scores,\n       COUNT(*) AS total\n  FROM images WHERE id BETWEEN 167287 AND 168029;\n-- with_scores: 0, total: 733\n```\n\nNo `image_phase_status` rows existed for phase_id=3 (scoring) on any of the 733 ids.\n\n## Hypothesis\n\nThe scoring runner appears to enumerate work from `image_phase_status` rows that are missing rather than from the explicit `resolved_image_ids` list, and exits cleanly when its scope query returns 0. `skip_existing: true` is in the payload but should not suppress 733 unscored images.\n\nGallery-side mitigation already merged (G5, gallery v7.7): `scheduleProcessingForImages` now calls `markImagePhasesPending(imageIds)` in the API-success branch so `not_started` rows exist for `scoring`/`culling`/`keywords` before the runner starts. The next syncΓåÆpipeline run after that change should give the scoring runner a non-empty scope. But the runner itself should still honor `resolved_image_ids` even when IPS rows are absent ΓÇö that's the real fix.\n\n## Likely files\n\n- `modules/scoring.py` / `modules/phase_executors.py` ΓÇö wherever the scoring runner builds its work list.\n- `modules/job_dispatcher.py` ΓÇö how `resolved_image_ids` from `queue_payload` is plumbed into the runner.\n- `modules/phases_policy.py` ΓÇö `skip_existing` semantics for scoring.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- Given a pipeline submit with `image_ids: [...]` and `operations: [\"score\"]`, the scoring runner enumerates exactly the supplied ids.\n- For each, it produces an `image_phase_status` row (`running` ΓåÆ `done`/`failed`/`skipped`) and writes the score columns when applicable.\n- `job_phases.scoring.images_in_scope` reflects the supplied id count (not 0).\n- Existing test: extend or add a Postgres-marked test in `tests/test_phase_executors.py` (or sibling) that submits a 3-image scoring job and asserts IPS rows and score columns post-run.\n\n## Severity\n\n**p1 / critical** ΓÇö current behavior silently completes the run without doing the work the user requested. The gallery and backend UIs both show the phase as `completed`, hiding the failure.","number":156,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Scoring runner short-circuits when given explicit image_ids list","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/156"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgssCzU","labels":["area:python","priority:p1","type:bug"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","status":"Todo","title":"Scoring runner short-circuits when given explicit image_ids list"},{"content":{"body":"## Symptom\n\nSame shape as #156. With a pipeline submit that includes `cluster` in `operations` and an explicit `image_ids` list, the culling phase marks itself **`completed`** in seconds with `images_in_scope = 0, images_processed = 0`, and produces no `image_phase_status` rows for `culling`. No images receive a `stack_id`.\n\nObserved on run 2365 (2026-05-10):\n\n```\nphase_order=3 culling   completed  in_scope=0  processed=0  failed=0\n```\n\nAfter completion:\n```\nSELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stack_id IS NOT NULL) AS with_stack,\n       COUNT(*) AS total\n  FROM images WHERE id BETWEEN 167287 AND 168029;\n-- with_stack: 0, total: 733\n```\n\n## Hypothesis\n\nLikely cascades from #156: clustering needs embeddings/scores from the scoring phase, which never ran. But the runner should still **fail loudly** (or skip with an explicit reason recorded in IPS) rather than silently complete with zero scope. Two possible fixes:\n\n1. **Defensive**: detect \"scoring did not produce embeddings\" and either fail the phase or write `skipped` IPS rows with a reason, instead of `completed in_scope=0`.\n2. **Scope honoring**: same as #156 ΓÇö enumerate from `resolved_image_ids` rather than from prerequisite IPS rows.\n\n## Likely files\n\n- `modules/clustering.py` / `modules/phase_executors.py` ΓÇö culling runner scope query.\n- `modules/phases_policy.py` ΓÇö `metadata ΓåÆ scoring ΓåÆ culling` dependency check.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- After a submit that includes `cluster` but where scoring produced no data, the culling phase records IPS rows as `skipped` (with `skip_reason`) or `failed`, not `done`.\n- `job_phases.culling.images_in_scope` reflects the supplied id count.\n- When scoring/embeddings ARE present, culling enumerates them correctly and writes stacks.\n- Resolves the silent-success failure mode visible in #156.\n\n## Severity\n\n**p1** ΓÇö currently the user sees no error indicator but the pipeline produced no stacks. Depends on #156 for the upstream fix; this ticket covers the loud-failure / scope-honoring contract.","number":157,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Culling runner short-circuits when given explicit image_ids list (likely cascades from scoring)","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/157"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgssCzs","labels":["area:python","priority:p1","type:bug"],"linked pull requests":["https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/pull/234"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","status":"In Progress","title":"Culling runner short-circuits when given explicit image_ids list (likely cascades from scoring)"},{"assignees":["synthet"],"content":{"body":"## Context\n\nFollow-up to #158. The fix in commit `a8dc6a1` makes `ReportCollector.set_scope_counts` push counters to `job_phases` immediately, so the Runs UI work-items panel shows a non-zero denominator from the moment the runner declares scope. That works for **indexing**, **metadata**, and **scoring** because those dispatch paths in `modules/job_dispatcher.py` already create a `ReportCollector` and call `set_scope_counts`.\n\n**Keywords (tag) and culling (cluster/selection) don't.** Their `job_phases.images_in_scope` stays at 0 for the entire active phase even after #158, because no collector is ever created on those dispatch paths.\n\n## Evidence\n\n- `modules/job_dispatcher.py:300-359` ΓÇö scoring dispatch builds a `ReportCollector(job_id, \"scoring\", run_mode)` and calls `set_scope_counts(in_scope=total_in_scope, targeted=len(resolved))`.\n- `modules/job_dispatcher.py:361-370` ΓÇö tagging dispatch passes `resolved_image_ids` to the runner but does NOT create a collector.\n- `modules/job_dispatcher.py:372-383` ΓÇö clustering dispatch same.\n- `modules/job_dispatcher.py:385-405` ΓÇö selection dispatch same.\n- `modules/tagging.py:388`, `modules/clustering.py:1048`, `modules/selection_runner.py:51` ΓÇö none of these `start_batch` signatures accept a `report_collector` parameter; none call `record_after/skip/failure`.\n\nSo the UX symptom of #158 persists for **Tagging** and **Similarity Clustering** stages.\n\n## Proposal ΓÇö two-stage delivery\n\n### Stage A (small, immediate value)\n\nIn each of the three dispatch branches in `job_dispatcher.py`:\n1. Build a `ReportCollector(job_id, phase_code, run_mode)`.\n2. Compute `in_scope` from `payload[\"scope_paths\"]` (same pattern as scoring, ~line 335-344).\n3. Call `set_scope_counts(in_scope=total_in_scope, targeted=len(resolved or []))` **before** invoking `runner.start_batch(...)`.\n4. The `_push_phase_counters_unlocked()` call inside `set_scope_counts` will write `job_phases.images_in_scope/targeted` immediately, even though the runner won't be calling `record_after` yet.\n\nThis alone closes the worst symptom: the Runs UI denominator changes from `0 / 0` to `N / N` from phase start. `images_processed` will still stay at 0 (no record_after wiring), but real per-image progress is observable via the existing `image_phase_status` table for users who want a moving bar.\n\n### Stage B (proper telemetry, separate ticket)\n\nAdd `report_collector` kwarg to `TaggingRunner.start_batch`, `ClusteringRunner.start_batch`, `SelectionRunner.start_batch`, and wire `record_after/record_skip/record_failure` into each runner's per-image branches. Then `images_processed/skipped/failed` increment during the run via the per-flush push (a8dc6a1) ΓÇö fully matching scoring/metadata/indexing.\n\nThis is a meatier change touching three runner modules and requires careful per-image hook placement. Leaving for follow-up.\n\n## Acceptance criteria (Stage A)\n\n- After submitting a single-stage `[\"tag\"]` or `[\"cluster\"]` job with `image_ids`, `job_phases.images_in_scope` is non-zero within seconds of the phase starting.\n- Same for selection.\n- No regression on scoring/metadata/indexing dispatch (`tests/test_job_dispatcher.py` stays green).\n\n## Severity\n\n**p2** ΓÇö cosmetic but covers the residual #158 surface (two of the five user-facing stages still show `0 / 0`).","number":159,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Wire ReportCollector into keywords/culling dispatch so job_phases denominator shows from phase start","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/159"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgssF6s","labels":["bug","area:python","priority:p2","type:bug"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Review","status":"Done","title":"Wire ReportCollector into keywords/culling dispatch so job_phases denominator shows from phase start"},{"assignees":["synthet"],"content":{"body":"## Context\n\nStage B follow-up to #159. The dispatcher now seeds `job_phases.images_in_scope/targeted` for the `tag` dispatch path (commit `83168fc`, v7.15.3), but the runner itself doesn't accept a `ReportCollector` and doesn't call `record_after/skip/failure` per image. So `job_phases.images_processed` stays at 0 throughout the entire keywords phase even after Stage A. The denominator is visible but the progress bar doesn't move.\n\n## Scope\n\n**TaggingRunner only.** ClusteringRunner and SelectionRunner do bulk / folder-level work rather than per-image, so the per-image collector pattern doesn't fit cleanly there ΓÇö handle those in a separate iteration if needed.\n\n## Plan\n\nChanges in `modules/tagging.py`:\n- Add `report_collector=None` to `TaggingRunner.start_batch` signature and pass it through to `_run_batch_internal`.\n- After the `explain_phase_run_decision` filter loop builds `final_images`, call `collector.set_scope_counts(in_scope=len(all_images_pre_filter), targeted=len(final_images))` so the per-flush push from #158 keeps `job_phases` in sync.\n- In the per-image branches inside the main `for row in all_images:` loop:\n  - **Success** (`produced_output` path, `set_image_phase_status(..., DONE)` at line 687-694): `collector.record_after(row['id'], snapshot, action=\"processed\")`.\n  - **No-output skip** (`set_image_phase_status(..., SKIPPED)` at line 697-706): `collector.record_skip(row['id'], reason=\"no tags produced\")`.\n  - **Exception path** (`set_image_phase_status(..., FAILED)` at line 707-724): `collector.record_failure(row['id'], str(e))`.\n  - Optional `record_before(...)` capturing current keywords for audit trail. (Cheap; mirrors scoring's pattern.)\n- At phase end (after the loop), call `collector.finalize()` once to flush the final counter snapshot and pending action rows.\n\nChanges in `modules/job_dispatcher.py`:\n- Replace the seed-and-discard `_seed_phase_scope(...)` call in the tag branch with a proper full-lifecycle collector that gets passed to `runner.start_batch(report_collector=collector)`.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- During an active keywords phase, `job_phases.images_processed` increments at the `_FLUSH_THRESHOLD` cadence (200 records) instead of staying at 0.\n- `job_phases.images_skipped` reflects images filtered by `explain_phase_run_decision` and \"no tags produced\" paths.\n- `job_phases.images_failed` reflects images that threw during inference.\n- `job_image_actions` rows are written per image (existing per-image audit trail used by scoring/metadata).\n- No regression: existing TaggingRunner tests stay green; existing dispatcher tests stay green.\n\n## Severity\n\n**p2** ΓÇö same as #158/#159: cosmetic but high-visibility. Closes the residual after Stage A.","number":160,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"TaggingRunner: wire ReportCollector for per-image progress (Stage B for keywords phase)","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/160"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgssOFw","labels":["bug","area:python","priority:p2","type:bug"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Review","status":"Done","title":"TaggingRunner: wire ReportCollector for per-image progress (Stage B for keywords phase)"},{"assignees":["synthet"],"content":{"body":"## Summary\n\nPhase 1 of a two-phase refinement of agent-facing infrastructure across the Vexlum Scoring / Driftara Gallery ecosystem. This issue covers the **gallery** side only; Phase 2 (backend mirror) will follow as a separate issue.\n\n## Scope\n\nFill gaps and clean up stale items in the gallery's agent infrastructure so AI/human agents have a single, accurate map of `.agent/`, `.cursor/`, `.claude/`, slash commands, MCP profiles, and workflows.\n\nConcrete deliverables:\n\n- Populate `.agent/AGENT_INFRA_STATUS.json` (machine-readable summary, schema per the multi-repo spec).\n- Expand `.agent/mcp_tools_reference.md` with a **read-only diagnostics profile** and a **high-risk write tools disable-by-default** list (covers `execute_code`, `execute_sql`, `set_config_value`, `run_processing_job`, `process_newly_imported_folders`, `rebase_file_paths`, `prune_missing_files`, `set_image_metadata`, `propagate_tags`, `manage_runners`).\n- Update `.agent/AGENT_INFRA_INVENTORY.md` (firebird-db deletion + review date).\n- Remove deprecated `.agent/skills/firebird-db/SKILL.md` (PostgreSQL is canonical via `electron/db/provider.ts` and backend `DB_SCHEMA.md`).\n- Refresh `.cursorrules` to a stub pointing to canonical sources (was Firebird-as-primary; now correctly cites PostgreSQL + backend authority).\n- Add `docs/log.md` entry.\n\n## Out of scope\n\n- Phase 2: backend (`image-scoring-backend`) agent-infra mirror ΓÇö separate issue to be filed.\n- Confirm-or-prune of third-party `.agent/skills/` (moltbook, memory-mcp, serena-integration) ΓÇö separate follow-up.\n\n## Validation\n\n- `npx tsc --noEmit` ΓÇö clean.\n- `npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit` ΓÇö clean.\n- `npm run doctor` ΓÇö PASS.\n- `npm run lint` ΓÇö pre-existing baseline only (no TS/TSX touched in this round).","number":84,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-gallery","title":"Refine agent infrastructure (Phase 1 ΓÇö gallery)","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery/issues/84"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgs8LPU","labels":["area:docs","priority:p2","type:chore"],"linked pull requests":["https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery/pull/85"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery","stage":"Done","status":"Done","title":"Refine agent infrastructure (Phase 1 ΓÇö gallery)"},{"assignees":["synthet"],"content":{"body":"## Summary\nThe post-run audit flags `scoring_incomplete` whenever `score_technical=0.0`, even when the scorer ran successfully and explicitly recorded that value. A single image with a legitimate zero technical score (e.g. all SPAQ/AVA submodels weighted to 0.0) triggers a permanent loop of `heal_workflow_scoring` runs.\n\n## Evidence\nImage 153393 (`/mnt/d/Photos/Z8/180-600mm/2026/2026-05-02/DSC_2680.NEF`):\n\n- `images.score=0.13, score_liqe=0.36, score_aesthetic=0.2378, score_technical=0.0`\n- `scores_json.summary.weighted_scores.technical = 0.0`\n- All three submodels (LIQE, SPAQ, AVA) report `status='success'`\n\nHeal jobs that each scored this image and still produced `issues_remaining` with `scoring_incomplete=1`:\n- 2310, 2327, 2344, 2362, 2375, 2378 (and several more interrupted attempts)\n\n## Expected behaviour\nAudit should treat a phase as complete when the scorer's row exists with `scores_json.models.*.status='success'`, not when `score_technical > 0`.\n\nSuggested predicate: `image is scoring_incomplete only if scores_json IS NULL OR no successful submodel`.\n\n## Notes\n- Search `modules/` for `scoring_incomplete` to find the audit predicate.\n- Add a regression test using image 153393's `scores_json` payload.\n\nCloses: surfaced via run-history audit (2026-05-15).","number":162,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Audit predicate treats legitimate score_technical=0.0 as scoring_incomplete (infinite heal requests":["https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/pull/176"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Review","status":"Done","title":"Audit predicate treats legitimate score_technical=0.0 as scoring_incomplete (infinite heal loop)"},{"content":{"body":"## Epic\n\nDecompose and execute [`docs/planning/models/IQA_MODEL_STACK_UPDATE_PROPOSAL.md`](https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/blob/master/docs/planning/models/IQA_MODEL_STACK_UPDATE_PROPOSAL.md): replace the legacy TensorFlow-heavy scoring ensemble with an **all-PyTorch** stack centered on **QPT V2 + TOPIQ-NR + LIQE**, via a risk-managed shadow ΓåÆ hybrid ΓåÆ cutover rollout.\n\n### Target stack & weights (from the proposal)\n\n| Score | QPT V2 | TOPIQ-NR | LIQE |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| General | 55% | 30% | 15% |\n| Aesthetic | 75% | ΓÇö | 25% |\n| Technical | 35% | 65% | ΓÇö |\n\n### Reality check ΓÇö the proposal's \"Current State\" table is stale\n\n- **Live ensemble is only SPAQ + AVA + LIQE** (KONIQ/PAQ2PIQ have DB columns but are **not** in the active fusion). Defaults: General `liqe 0.45 / ava 0.30 / spaq 0.25`; Technical `liqe 1.0`; Aesthetic `ava 0.55 / spaq 0.45` ΓÇö see `modules/score_normalization.py` (`DEFAULT_PERCENTILE_ANCHORS`, `DEFAULT_COMPOSITE_WEIGHTS`) and `config.example.json` (`scoring.fusion` / `scoring.models`). Live `config.json` omits these blocks and relies on code defaults.\n\n### Most of the machinery already exists ΓÇö this is \"add 2 wrappers + calibrate + evaluate + stage weights,\" not a rebuild\n\n- `IScoringModel` interface: `modules/engines/base.py` (`load()`, `predict()`, `normalize()`, `score_range`).\n- Config-driven registry with `enabled`/`shadow` semantics: `modules/engines/registry.py` (its docstring already uses `qpt_v2` as the shadow example).\n- Registry-driven host `MultiModelHost.run_all_models`: `modules/engines/host.py` ΓÇö **but** its docstring warns *\"wiring into the pipeline happens in a later step; for now the host exists alongside the legacy path\"* ΓåÆ must verify the registry path is live.\n- Per-model storage with shadow flag: `image_model_scores` table (`migrations/versions/0016_image_model_scores.py`): `model_name, raw_score, normalized, status, is_shadow, model_version`. New models need **no migration** to store scores. Legacy typed columns (`score_spaq/ava/liqe/...`) are dual-written for Electron.\n- Canonical fusion: `modules/score_normalization.py` reads `scoring.fusion` (`get_composite_weights()`, `get_percentile_anchors()`).\n- **TOPIQ-NR / Q-Align wrappers do not exist yet** (CLAUDE.md lists `modules/topiq.py`/`modules/qalign.py` aspirationally). LIQE is integrated via **pyiqa** (`modules/engines/liqe_model.py`); **TOPIQ-NR is in pyiqa too** ΓåÆ its wrapper mirrors LIQE. **QPT V2 is not in pyiqa** ΓåÆ needs a custom PyTorch wrapper loading the HiViT checkpoint (`KeiChiTse/QPT-V2`).\n\n### Sub-issues (dependency-ordered)\n\n- [ ] #181 ΓÇö Spike: QPT V2 + TOPIQ-NR local inference feasibility *(Ready)*\n- [ ] #182 ΓÇö TOPIQ-NR scoring engine wrapper *(dep: #181)*\n- [ ] #183 ΓÇö QPT V2 scoring engine wrapper *(dep: #181)*\n- [ ] #184 ΓÇö Verify/finish registry (`MultiModelHost`) as the live scoring path *(dep: #182, #183)*\n- [ ] #185 ΓÇö Calibration layer + percentile anchors for new models *(dep: #184)*\n- [ ] #186 ΓÇö Disagreement diagnostics *(dep: #184)*\n- [ ] #187 ΓÇö Evaluation harness (old vs new ensemble) *(dep: #185)*\n- [ ] #188 ΓÇö Staged weight migration: shadow ΓåÆ hybrid ΓåÆ cutover *(dep: #187)*\n- [ ] #189 ΓÇö Retire legacy models + all-PyTorch cleanup *(dep: #188)*\n- [ ] #190 ΓÇö API / settings / config + docs *(dep: #182, #183)*\n- [ ] #191 ΓÇö Tests for new wrappers + fusion *(dep: #182, #183, #185)*\n\n### Note on benchmark numbers\n\nThe two local IAA research reports disagree on QPT V2's AVA SRCC (`IAA_MODELS_SURVEY_2024_2025.md` Γëê0.82 vs `IAA_MODELS_LOCAL_DEPLOYMENT.md` 0.865). [image-scoring-backend#180](https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/180): update **Driftara Gallery** UI, IPC/SQL query layer, and types so the desktop app reflects the new **QPT V2 + TOPIQ-NR + LIQE** scoring stack and staged retirement of legacy per-model scores (SPAQ, AVA, KONIQ, PAQ2PIQ).\r\n\r\n**Backend owns:** inference wrappers, fusion/calibration, `image_model_scores` storage, dual-write policy, OpenAPI, and composite columns (`score_general`, `score_technical`, `score_aesthetic`). See backend proposal: [`IQA_MODEL_STACK_UPDATE_PROPOSAL.md`](https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/blob/master/docs/planning/models/IQA_MODEL_STACK_UPDATE_PROPOSAL.md).\r\n\r\n**Gallery owns:** everything the renderer and `electron/db.ts` expose after backend contracts land ΓÇö per-model score display, sort/filter options, pipeline copy, TypeScript types, and tests.\r\n\r\n### What stays stable (no change expected)\r\n\r\nComposite scores drive most gallery UX today and should **keep the same column names**:\r\n\r\n- `score_general`, `score_technical`, `score_aesthetic` ΓÇö sort defaults, stack rep selection, backup planner, duplicate finder, filter dropdowns (`electron/db.ts`, `AppContent.tsx`, `GalleryGrid.tsx`, `DuplicateFinder.tsx`).\r\n\r\nDuring shadow ΓåÆ hybrid ΓåÆ cutover, composite values may shift numerically; gallery does **not** need a migration for that ΓÇö backend calibration handles it.\r\n\r\n### What must change\r\n\r\n| Area | Current state | Target |\r\n|------|---------------|--------|\r\n| **Per-model bars** | `ImageViewer.tsx` shows SPAQ / AVA / LIQE when `> 0` | Show **QPT V2**, **TOPIQ-NR**, **LIQE**; phase out SPAQ/AVA after backend cutover |\r\n| **Per-model sort** | `AppContent.tsx` options include `score_spaq`, `score_ava`, `score_liqe`, ΓÇª | Add new per-model sorts if backend dual-writes columns; remove deprecated sorts after cutover |\r\n| **SQL SELECT lists** | `electron/db.ts` whitelists `score_spaq`, `score_ava`, `score_koniq`, `score_paq2piq`, `score_liqe` | Extend for new columns **or** join `image_model_scores` once backend contract is fixed |\r\n| **Stack cache min/max** | `stack_cache` aggregation includes legacy per-model columns | Same extension for new models |\r\n| **Pipeline copy** | `pipelineLabels.ts` says \"MUSIQ, LIQE, TOPIQ, Q-Align\" | Align with backend [`PIPELINE_TERMINOLOGY.md`](https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/blob/main/docs/technical/PIPELINE_TERMINOLOGY.md) and live stack |\r\n| **Types / tests** | `electron/types.ts`, hooks, `db.getImages.test.ts`, `ImageViewer.test.tsx` | Update when schema or IPC payloads change |\r\n\r\n### Coordination protocol\r\n\r\nFollow [`.agent/workflows/cross_repo_contract_change.md`](https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery/blob/main/.agent/workflows/cross_repo_contract_change.md): **backend contract first**, then gallery `electron/db.ts` / API types / UI. Disposition (each branch)  Assess -> cherry-pick (if partial) -> open PR -> merge -> delete remote branch.  ## Backend counterpart  Backend epic: https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/197 (`cross-repo`).","number":107,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-gallery","title":"chore: inventory stale remote branches ahead of main (2026-05-20)","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery/issues/107"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtQ_ZA","labels":["codex","area:docs","priority:p3","type:chore","cross-repo"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery","status":"Todo","title":"chore: inventory stale remote branches ahead of main (2026-05-20)"},{"content":{"body":"## Goal\nHarden cross-cutting architecture after architecture_review: docs truth, job lifecycle, gallery contracts, API split, contract drift gates, diagnostics consolidation.\n\n## Canonical references\n- docs/CANONICAL_SOURCES.md\n- docs/technical/AGENT_COORDINATION.md\n- docs/technical/API_CONTRACT.md\n\n## Sub-issues\nLinked via GitHub sub-issues (same repo) or cross-repo URLs in child bodies.\n\n## Out of scope / obsolete\nFirebird as primary engine; monolithic undocumented API.\n","number":198,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Epic: Architecture hardening (post architecture_review)","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/198"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRAoY","labels":["area:python","area:docs","priority:p1","cross-repo","type:epic"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","status":"Todo","title":"Epic: Architecture hardening (post architecture_review)"},{"content":{"body":"Source: `architecture_review.md`.\n\n## Problem\nSome active backend architecture docs still describe Firebird/default connector behavior that no longer matches current runtime code. Current `modules/db_connector/factory.py` supports Postgres/API and maps legacy `database.engine=\"firebird\"` to Postgres with a warning.\n\n## Impact\nAgents and developers can make incorrect architecture, schema, and cross-repo recommendations. This is especially risky for gallery integration work because PostgreSQL + pgvector is the current primary architecture.\n\n## Recommended fix\n- Update active architecture docs to describe PostgreSQL + pgvector and API connector behavior as current runtime truth.\n- Move Firebird connector/default-engine details to historical migration docs.\n- Keep Firebird references only where they are explicitly historical or compatibility-shim context.\n- Add a lightweight docs check/search for stale claims such as \"Firebird default\" and active `database.engine='firebird'` guidance.\n\n## Likely files\n- `docs/architecture/system-overview.md`\n- `docs/architecture/DB_CONNECTOR.md`\n- `docs/technical/DB_SCHEMA.md`\n- `docs/CANONICAL_SOURCES.md`\n- `docs/technical/AGENT_COORDINATION.md`\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n- Active architecture docs consistently identify PostgreSQL + pgvector as primary.\n- Firebird language is marked historical unless current code proves active support.\n- Docs mention that legacy `firebird` config maps to Postgres in current connector code.\n- `architecture_review.md` no longer conflicts with canonical docs on database ownership.","number":169,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Architecture: clean up stale Firebird-era docs and canonical source drift","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/169"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRAo4","labels":["area:docs","priority:p1","type:chore"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","status":"Todo","title":"Architecture: clean up stale Firebird-era docs and canonical source drift"},{"content":{"body":"Source: `architecture_review.md`.\n\n## Problem\nJob/run state transitions are spread across API handlers, `JobDispatcher`, `PipelineOrchestrator`, and DB helper code. Cancellation semantics differ by endpoint: `/api/jobs/{job_id}/cancel` treats running cancellation as unsupported while `/api/runs/{run_id}/cancel` can directly mark running/pending/paused/interrupted runs cancelled.\n\n## Impact\nClients can observe different cancellation behavior depending on endpoint. A run may appear cancelled while a runner continues work, causing stale `image_phase_status` rows, misleading UI status, and write-after-cancel behavior. This overlaps with narrower recovery bugs such as #161, #163, #165, and #166.\n\n## Recommended fix\n- Introduce a central job lifecycle/state-machine service.\n- Define allowed transitions for queued, running, paused, interrupted, cancel_requested, cancelled/canceled, failed, and completed states.\n- Normalize API/storage vocabulary for `canceled` vs `cancelled`.\n- Require runner acknowledgement for running cancellation.\n- Route `/api/jobs/*`, `/api/runs/*`, dispatcher, and orchestrator transitions through this service.\n\n## Likely files\n- `modules/api.py`\n- `modules/job_dispatcher.py`\n- `modules/pipeline_orchestrator.py`\n- DB job helper modules\n- `docs/technical/API_CONTRACT.md`\n- `docs/technical/RUNS_QUEUE_AND_RESTART.md`\n\n## Tests/checks\n- API tests for queued and running cancellation.\n- Dispatcher integration tests for cancellation acknowledgement.\n- Stale-running recovery tests.\n- OpenAPI diff and docs update.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n- One documented lifecycle transition table exists.\n- Jobs and runs endpoints agree on cancellation/pause/retry semantics.\n- Running cancellation cannot silently mark a run terminal while work continues.\n\n## Canonical references\n- [CANONICAL_SOURCES.md](docs/CANONICAL_SOURCES.md)\n- [AGENT_COORDINATION.md](docs/technical/AGENT_COORDINATION.md)\n- Primary DB: PostgreSQL + pgvector; legacy `database.engine=firebird` maps to Postgres with warning.\n","number":170,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Architecture: centralize job/run lifecycle state transitions and cancellation semantics","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/170"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRApw","labels":["area:python","priority:p1","type:refactor"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","status":"Todo","title":"Architecture: centralize job/run lifecycle state transitions and cancellation semantics"},{"content":{"body":"Source: `architecture_review.md`.\n\n## Problem\nDriftara Gallery can query backend-owned PostgreSQL tables directly in `postgres` provider mode. The gallery currently depends on internal tables/columns such as `images`, score columns, normalized keywords, folder phase aggregates, `image_phase_status`, `pipeline_phases`, and stack-related fields.\n\n## Impact\nBackend schema cleanup, score fact-table migration, keyword normalization, or phase-schema changes can break the desktop app even if REST remains compatible. Existing issues #103 and #111 cover related database evolution, but this issue tracks the integration contract layer needed to make those changes safe for the gallery.\n\n## Recommended fix\nChoose and document one stable read surface for gallery:\n\n- Preferred: REST DTOs for gallery image/folder/stack/phase reads.\n- Acceptable transitional path: versioned backend-owned DB views such as `gallery_images_v1`, `gallery_folders_v1`, and `gallery_stacks_v1`.\n\nThe gallery should query only the stable surface in direct-Postgres mode, not internal migration-sensitive tables.\n\n## Likely files\n- Backend migrations\n- `modules/db_postgres.py`\n- `modules/api.py` or split API routers\n- `docs/technical/DB_SCHEMA.md`\n- `docs/technical/API_CONTRACT.md`\n- Gallery follow-up: `electron/db.ts`, `electron/db/provider.ts`\n\n## Tests/checks\n- Backend migration/view tests.\n- Gallery query smoke tests against migrated Postgres.\n- OpenAPI/contract check if using REST.\n- Cross-repo handoff in `docs/technical/AGENT_COORDINATION.md`.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n- A stable gallery read contract is documented.\n- Direct gallery Postgres mode no longer requires internal table knowledge for primary browse views.\n- Backend schema PRs have a clear gallery compatibility checklist.\n\n## Canonical references\n- [CANONICAL_SOURCES.md](docs/CANONICAL_SOURCES.md)\n- [AGENT_COORDINATION.md](docs/technical/AGENT_COORDINATION.md)\n- Primary DB: PostgreSQL + pgvector; legacy `database.engine=firebird` maps to Postgres with warning.\n","number":171,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Architecture: define stable gallery read contracts for schema-safe desktop integration","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/171"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRAqU","labels":["area:python","area:db","priority:p1","type:refactor","cross-repo"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","status":"Todo","title":"Architecture: define stable gallery read contracts for schema-safe desktop integration"},{"content":{"body":"Source: `architecture_review.md`.\n\n## Problem\nThe gallery API provider can issue database-style SQL through backend `/api/db/query`. On the gallery side, API-mode `runTransaction()` is sequential HTTP calls, not one ACID transaction. Backend also exposes `/api/db/transaction`, but the cross-repo contract and intended write semantics need to be tightened.\n\n## Impact\nIn API mode, multi-step writes can partially apply when a later query fails. Generic SQL-over-HTTP is also a schema-leaky contract that can bypass domain-level validation if allowed to grow unchecked.\n\n## Recommended fix\n- Decide whether SQL-over-HTTP is read-only product infrastructure or a trusted local admin bridge.\n- If writes remain supported, require atomic `/api/db/transaction` for multi-statement write batches.\n- Document write-token requirements and transaction limitations.\n- Prefer domain REST endpoints for gallery write workflows.\n- Add tests that prove failed write batches roll back.\n\n## Likely files\n- `modules/api_db.py`\n- `modules/db_connector/api.py`\n- `docs/technical/API_CONTRACT.md`\n- `docs/architecture/DB_CONNECTOR.md`\n- Gallery follow-up: `electron/db/provider.ts`\n\n## Tests/checks\n- Backend TestClient tests for `/api/db/transaction` success and rollback.\n- Gallery provider tests for API transaction behavior.\n- Security review for `database.query_token` behavior and disabled-write defaults.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n- SQL-over-HTTP write semantics are documented and enforced.\n- API-mode multi-step writes are atomic or explicitly unsupported.\n- Gallery API mode cannot silently perform partial transaction-like writes.\n\n## Canonical references\n- [CANONICAL_SOURCES.md](docs/CANONICAL_SOURCES.md)\n- [AGENT_COORDINATION.md](docs/technical/AGENT_COORDINATION.md)\n- Primary DB: PostgreSQL + pgvector; legacy `database.engine=firebird` maps to Postgres with warning.\n","number":172,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Architecture: make SQL-over-HTTP make SQL-over-HTTP transaction semantics safe or read-only"},{"content":{"body":"Source: `architecture_review.md`.\n\n## Problem\n`modules/api.py` is a very large router file that combines many API surfaces: scoring, tagging, clustering, jobs, runs, pipeline control, scope, similarity, raw preview, diagnostics, and compatibility endpoints.\n\n## Impact\nAPI changes are hard to review, OpenAPI diffs are noisy, and unrelated surfaces are easy to regress while editing one endpoint family.\n\n## Recommended fix\nSplit the router by domain while preserving route paths, response models, and OpenAPI behavior:\n\n- `api/images.py`\n- `api/jobs.py`\n- `api/runs.py`\n- `api/pipeline.py`\n- `api/similarity.py`\n- `api/diagnostics.py`\n- `api/raw_preview.py`\n- compatibility/router assembly module as needed\n\nBe careful with Gradio/FastAPI mount order noted in `webui.py` and `modules/ui/app.py`.\n\n## Likely files\n- `modules/api.py`\n- `modules/ui/app.py`\n- `webui.py`\n- API tests that import `create_api_router()`\n- OpenAPI generation artifacts\n\n## Tests/checks\n- Existing API tests.\n- OpenAPI diff before/after split.\n- WebUI smoke start.\n- Route list snapshot to confirm paths remain stable.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n- Public API paths and response models remain unchanged.\n- Router code is organized by domain.\n- OpenAPI diff is empty or explicitly documented.\n\n## Canonical references\n- [CANONICAL_SOURCES.md](docs/CANONICAL_SOURCES.md)\n- [AGENT_COORDINATION.md](docs/technical/AGENT_COORDINATION.md)\n- Primary DB: PostgreSQL + pgvector; legacy split monolithic API router into domain routers without changing contracts"},{"content":{"body":"Source: `architecture_review.md`.\n\n## Problem\nPipeline terminology and API types are duplicated between backend and gallery. Backend `frontend/src/types/api.ts`, backend docs, gallery `src/constants/pipelineLabels.ts`, gallery API service/types, and generated OpenAPI artifacts can drift.\n\n## Impact\nA backend route, phase-code, submit-token, label, or response shape can change without the gallery failing at compile time. This creates runtime integration failures and inconsistent user-facing language.\n\n## Recommended fix\n- Keep backend OpenAPI generated and checked when REST behavior changes.\n- Ensure gallery `api-contract/openapi.json` is updated and validated in cross-repo changes.\n- Add a generated or validated pipeline terminology artifact containing phase codes, submit tokens, job_type mappings, and user-facing labels.\n- Add a CI/pre-PR check that fails on stale gallery API types or terminology constants.\n\n## Likely files\n- `docs/technical/API_CONTRACT.md`\n- `docs/reference/api/openapi.yaml`\n- `openapi.json`\n- `frontend/src/types/api.ts`\n- `modules/phases.py`\n- Gallery follow-up: `api-contract/openapi.json`, `electron/apiTypes.ts`, `src/constants/pipelineLabels.ts`\n\n## Tests/checks\n- Backend OpenAPI diff/check.\n- Gallery `npm run contract:check` and `npm run contract:validate`.\n- Terminology sync test comparing generated artifact to checked-in constants.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n- API contract drift is detectable before merge.\n- Phase labels/codes have one canonical source or an automated sync check.\n- Cross-repo PR handoffs include backend and gallery verification commands.\n\n## Canonical references\n- [CANONICAL_SOURCES.md](docs/CANONICAL_SOURCES.md)\n- [AGENT_COORDINATION.md](docs/technical/AGENT_COORDINATION.md)\n- Primary DB: PostgreSQL + pgvector; Without shared implementation, these surfaces can drift and report different results for the same environment or run state.\n\n## Impact\nOperators and agents may get inconsistent health/status information depending on whether they use `scripts/doctor.py`, MCP tools, API endpoints, or debug bundles.\n\n## Recommended fix\n- Put shared diagnostic checks behind reusable functions consumed by implementation model.\n\n## Canonical references\n- [CANONICAL_SOURCES.md](docs/CANONICAL_SOURCES.md)\n- [AGENT_COORDINATION.md](docs/technical/AGENT_COORDINATION.md)\n- Primary DB: PostgreSQL +
