Run lifecycle, recovery, and phase-status bugs"},{"assignees":["synthet"],"content":{"body":"## Summary\nWhen a job is cancelled (or a runner stops without a heartbeat), the stale-run reconciler force-finalises `image_phase_status` rows to `status='failed'` without checking whether the phase's actual output columns have been persisted. Images whose scoring already completed end up flagged `failed`, then the post-run auditor reports `scoring_incomplete`, triggering `heal_workflow_scoring` runs that loop indefinitely.\n\n## Evidence\nFolder `/mnt/d/Photos/Z8/180-600mm/2026/2026-05-02`, after job 2423 was cancelled:\n\n- 17 `image_phase_status` rows for phase `scoring`: `status='failed'`, `last_error='stale_running_reconciled:job_cancelled'`, `attempt_count=10`\n- Example image 152534 (`DSC_1818.NEF`) ΓÇö `images.score=0.81, score_liqe=0.84, score_aesthetic=0.85, score_technical=0.76`\n\nSame folder shows 19 `heal_workflow_scoring` runs and 7 `issues_remaining` audits in the last 500 jobs.\n\nOther related rows: 356 culling rows with `last_error='reconcile_stale:no_heartbeat'` and 65 with `stale_running_reconciled` ΓÇö same class of bug.\n\n## Expected behaviour\nWhen the reconciler force-finalises a `running` phase row for a cancelled / heartbeat-stale job, it should:\n1. Check whether the phase's canonical output columns on `images` (or the phase's expected side effects) are present.\n2. If yes ΓåÆ set `status='done'` with a `last_error` noting the auto-recovery.\n3. If no ΓåÆ keep the current behaviour (`failed`).\n\n## Notes\n- Code path: search `modules/` for `stale_running_reconciled` and `reconcile_stale`.\n- The fix should be runner-agnostic per-phase (each phase declares its \"completion proof\" predicate).\n- Add a unit test that simulates job cancellation after scoring has persisted scores and asserts the row ends as `done`, not `failed`.\n\nCloses: surfaced via run-history audit (2026-05-15).","number":161,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Reconciler flips already-scored images to phase_status='failed' on job cancel","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/161"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRA0o","labels":["area:python","priority:p0","type:bug"],"linked pull requests":["https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/pull/207"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","status":"Done","title":"Reconciler flips already-scored images to phase_status='failed' on job cancel"},{"content":{"body":"## Summary\nA late transient `[Errno 5] Input/output error: '/app/config.json'` flips an otherwise successful metadata run to overall `status='failed'`, even when 99% of images were processed. The execution_report (which captures the partial success) is also discarded.\n\n## Evidence\nJob 2106 ΓÇö `/mnt/d/Photos/Z8/180-600mm/2026/2026-05-02`:\n- duration 39:25\n- log tail: `[Errno 5] Input/output error: '/app/config.json'`\n- `queue_payload.execution_report.phases.metadata`:\n  ```\n  images_in_scope: 877\n  images_targeted: 877\n  images_processed: 872\n  images_skipped: 5\n  images_failed: 0\n  ```\n- `status='failed'` ΓÇö downstream phases never followed up.\n\n## Expected behaviour\nOption A: introduce a `completed_with_errors` job state with the execution_report persisted, so phase_followup can still proceed for the 872 successes.\n\nOption B (minimum): always persist `execution_report` on failure too, and let the auditor decide whether to schedule a partial follow-up.\n\n## Notes\n- Config readers in the metadata runner should not crash the whole job on a single transient EIO. Cache config in memory at runner-start and re-read only on explicit reload.\n- Add a test that injects an EIO during the final commit phase and asserts the run reports `completed_with_errors`.\n\nCloses: surfaced via run-history audit (2026-05-15).","number":163,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Metadata job marked 'failed' on late EIO although 872/877 images succeeded; execution_report lost","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/163"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRA1U","labels":["area:python","priority:p2","type:bug"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","status":"Todo","title":"Metadata job marked 'failed' on late EIO although 872/877 images succeeded; execution_report lost"},{"content":{"body":"## Summary\nThe Runs submit endpoint accepts identical submissions for paths that don't exist on the runner's filesystem, producing repeated `Input path not found` failures within seconds.\n\n## Evidence\n6 failed indexing jobs against 2 paths in the last 500 jobs:\n- `/mnt/d/Photos/Z6ii/28-400mm/2026/2026-05-03` ΓåÆ jobs 2099, 2100, 2104, 2108 (4 in <1 min)\n- `/mnt/d/Photos/Z8/180-600mm/2026/2026-05-02` ΓåÆ jobs 2102, 2105, 2106 (3 in <1 min)\n- `/mnt/d/Photos/Z8/180-600mm/2026/2026-05-03` ΓåÆ jobs 2103, 2107 (2 in <1 min)\n\nTrigger on every one of these: `tool_id='run_submit'` from the UI.\n\n## Expected behaviour\n- Validate `input_path` exists on the runner before enqueueing; return 400 if missing.\n- Reject submission if an identical `(input_path, run_mode)` failed within the last 60 seconds with `Input path not found` ΓÇö surface the prior failure in the response.\n\n## Notes\n- Endpoint: `/api/runs/submit` in `modules/api.py`.\n- Also normalise Windows-style paths (`D:\\ΓÇª`) to canonical `/mnt/d/ΓÇª` at the API boundary (see job 2411 which used the Windows form).","number":164,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"/api/runs/submit accepts the same nonexistent path repeatedly; no dedup/validation","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/164"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRA1w","labels":["area:python","priority:p3","type:bug"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","status":"Todo","title":"/api/runs/submit accepts the same nonexistent path repeatedly; no dedup/validation"},{"content":{"body":"## Summary\n103 of 271 recent `heal_workflow_*` jobs have `queue_payload.post_run_audit = null`. Without the audit, the orchestrator has no signal to decide whether to schedule another follow-up ΓÇö either thrash continues or real gaps are missed.\n\n## Evidence\nAffected especially:\n- `heal_workflow_metadata` ΓÇö null on all 4 sampled runs (job 2150 example).\n- A sizeable fraction of `heal_workflow_keywords` and `heal_workflow_scoring` runs.\n\n## Expected behaviour\nEvery heal kind should emit a `post_run_audit` block with `status='clean'|'issues_remaining'` and per-phase `issue_counts`, matching what `heal_workflow_culling` does today.\n\n## Notes\n- Look for the audit step in the heal runners (`modules/engine.py`, runner-specific paths).\n- Likely missing wiring on the metadata runner.\n\nCloses: surfaced via run-history audit (2026-05-15).","number":165,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"post_run_audit is null on ~38% of heals (including every heal_workflow_metadata)","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/165"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRA2A","labels":["area:python","priority:p2","type:bug"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","status":"Todo","title":"post_run_audit is null on ~38% of heals (including every heal_workflow_metadata)"},{"content":{"body":"## Summary\nFor some folders, only a subset of in-scope images have rows in `image_phase_status` for downstream phases. Heal tools iterate existing rows only, so images without rows are invisible to the healer and the orchestrator declares the folder clean.\n\n## Evidence\nFolder `/mnt/d/Photos/Z8/180-600mm/2026/2026-05-02` ΓÇö 877 images:\n\n| phase | done | failed | not_started | skipped | total rows |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n| indexing | 877 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 877 |\n| metadata | 646 | 0 | 0 | 231 | 877 |\n| scoring | 858 | 17 | 2 | 0 | 877 |\n| culling | 540 | 0 | 0 | 0 | **540 (missing 337)** |\n| keywords | 0 | 0 | 877 | 0 | 877 |\n\nFolder `/mnt/d/Photos/Z8/180-600mm/2026/2026-05-03` ΓÇö 1,544 images:\n\n| phase | done | not_started | running | skipped | total rows |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n| bird_species | 1,327 | 0 | 0 | 0 | **1,327 (missing 217)** |\n| keywords | 941 | 570 | 1 | 32 | 1,544 |\n\n## Expected behaviour\nEither:\n- Every phase runner upserts an `image_phase_status` row for every image in scope (even if only as `not_started`), so the audit can detect gaps.\n- Or the auditor counts gaps by joining `images` to `image_phase_status` (`LEFT JOIN ... WHERE phase_status IS NULL`) instead of trusting that all rows exist.\n\nAdd a one-shot migration / repair tool to backfill missing rows for current data.\n\n## Notes\n- Probably caused by the phase scheduler narrowing the image set after a prior failure / skip.\n- Consider unique constraint `(image_id, phase_id)` to make backfill safe.\n\nCloses: surfaced via run-history audit Gallery embeddings and similarity UI"},{"content":{"body":"## Goal\nOpenAPI drift gates, generated types, API DB transaction semantics, main-process split.\n\n## Canonical references\n- docs/CANONICAL_SOURCES.md (backend)\n- npm run contract:check\n- Backend counterpart: #174\n\n## Sub-issues\nLinked via GitHub sub-issues (same repo) or cross-repo URLs in child bodies.\n\n## Out of scope / obsolete\nHand-maintained apiTypes without OpenAPI sync.\n","number":109,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-gallery","title":"Epic: Cross-repo API and contract hardening","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery/issues/109"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRA-k","labels":["area:electron","priority:p1","cross-repo","type:epic"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery","status":"Todo","title":"Epic: Cross-repo API and contract hardening"},{"assignees":["synthet"],"content":{"body":"## Problem\nThe gallery API snapshot and handwritten API types are drifting from the backend OpenAPI contract. The most important confirmed mismatch is `PipelineSubmitRequest`: gallery code still sends `input_path` + `operations`, while the backend OpenAPI schema currently documents `workspace_target` + `stage_codes`.\n\n## Evidence\n- Gallery `electron/apiTypes.ts` defines `PipelineSubmitRequest.input_path` and `operations`.\n- Backend `docs/reference/api/openapi.yaml` defines `PipelineSubmitRequest.workspace_target` and `stage_codes`.\n- Backend `docs/technical/API_CONTRACT.md` still documents `input_path` and `operations`, so backend docs and OpenAPI are not aligned.\n- `npm run contract:check` reports live API drift.\n- `npm run contract:validate` reports 106 issues, including missing `stage_codes` / `workspace_target` and extra `input_path` / `operations`.\n\n## Impact\nPipeline submissions from the gallery may fail or rely on undocumented compatibility aliases. This also weakens future endpoint work because generated types, handwritten types, and docs disagree.\n\n## Recommended fix\nCoordinate with `image-scoring-backend` first to settle the canonical request shape and compatibility policy, then update the gallery snapshot/client.\n\nRelated: #76 tracks endpoint updates generally; this issue is specifically for contract reconciliation and pipeline submit payload safety.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n- [ ] Backend API docs, backend OpenAPI, and live `/openapi.json` agree for `PipelineSubmitRequest`.\n- [ ] Gallery `api-contract/openapi.json` is refreshed from the canonical backend schema.\n- [ ] Gallery `electron/api.generated.ts` is regenerated.\n- [ ] Gallery `electron/apiService.ts` sends the canonical payload shape or an explicitly documented compatibility shape.\n- [ ] `npm run contract:check` passes.\n- [ ] `npm run contract:validate` either passes or has an intentional, documented ignore list for endpoints not consumed by the gallery.\n\n## Checks\n```bash\nnpm run contract:check\nnpm run contract:validate\nnpm run generate:api-types\nnpx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit\nnpm run test:run -- electron/apiService.test.ts\n```","number":87,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-gallery","title":"Reconcile gallery API contract with backend OpenAPI","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery/issues/87"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRA_I","labels":["codex","area:electron","priority:p1","type:chore","cross-repo"],"linked pull requests":["https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery/pull/116"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery","status":"Done","title":"Reconcile gallery API contract with backend OpenAPI"},{"content":{"body":"## Problem\nThe gallery `ApiConnector` presents the same `IDatabaseConnector` interface as direct Postgres, but its transaction implementation is only sequential HTTP calls. That is not equivalent to an ACID transaction and can partially apply writes if one request fails.\n\n## Evidence\n- `electron/db/provider.ts` documents `ApiConnector.runTransaction()` as sequential HTTP queries, not a shared backend session.\n- Backend DB connector docs describe `/api/db/transaction` for atomic write batches and `X-DB-Write-Token` gating for mutating `/api/db/query` calls.\n- Gallery `ApiConnector.query()` posts to `/api/db/query` without an explicit `write` flag or write token support.\n\n## Impact\nWhen the gallery runs in `database.engine = \"api\"` mode, direct DB-style writes and transaction-like operations may behave differently from Postgres mode. Import/sync fallback and phase-status writes are the highest-risk areas.\n\n## Recommended fix\nChoose and document one of these policies:\n\n1. API DB mode is read-only in gallery, and all mutations go through backend domain endpoints.\n2. API DB mode supports writes only through explicit backend `/api/db/transaction` and configured write-token handling.\n\nPrefer domain endpoints for operations with business semantics, especially import/sync, image updates, queueing, and phase status changes.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n- [ ] `ApiConnector` behavior is documented as read-only or write-capable with explicit transaction semantics.\n- [ ] If write-capable, `runTransaction()` uses backend `/api/db/transaction` for write batches.\n- [ ] Write-token configuration is supported or writes fail with a clear error.\n- [ ] Import/sync behavior in API mode is covered by tests.\n- [ ] UI diagnostics distinguish direct Postgres mode from API DB mode.\n\n## Checks\n```bash\nnpm run test:run -- electron/db/provider.test.ts electron/config.examples.test.ts\nnpx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit\nnpm run doctor\n```","number":88,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-gallery","title":"Clarify and harden API DB provider write/transaction semantics","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery/issues/88"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRA_s","labels":["codex","area:db","area:electron","priority:p1","type:refactor","cross-repo"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery","status":"Todo","title":"Clarify and harden API DB provider write/transaction semantics"},{"content":{"body":"## Problem\nThe gallery keeps handwritten backend REST interfaces in `electron/apiTypes.ts` while also maintaining generated OpenAPI types in `electron/api.generated.ts`. This creates two sources of truth and allows request/response drift to survive until runtime.\n\n## Evidence\n- `electron/apiTypes.ts` says generated types live in `api.generated.ts` and new code should migrate incrementally.\n- `npm run contract:validate` reports schema and field mismatches between handwritten interfaces, service usage, and OpenAPI.\n- `electron/apiService.ts` imports handwritten request/response types for backend calls.\n\n## Impact\nBackend contract changes can compile in the gallery even when payloads are stale, because handwritten types are not guaranteed to match OpenAPI.\n\n## Proposed change\nMigrate `ApiService` and preload API methods toward generated OpenAPI types. Keep small adapter types only where the renderer needs a stable UI model that intentionally differs from backend wire models.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n- [ ] `ApiService` request/response types for consumed endpoints come from `electron/api.generated.ts` or typed helpers derived from it.\n- [ ] Handwritten `apiTypes.ts` is reduced to UI/domain adapters and documented exceptions.\n- [ ] `contract:validate` no longer reports consumed-endpoint mismatches.\n- [ ] Tests cover at least health/status, pipeline submit, jobs, raw preview, similarity, and scope tree calls.\n\n## Checks\n```bash\nnpm run generate:api-types\nnpm run contract:validate\nnpm run test:run -- electron/apiService.test.ts src/services/apiClient.test.ts src/services/WebSocketService.test.ts\nnpx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit\nnpx tsc -b\n```","number":89,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-gallery","title":"Migrate backend API client types to generated OpenAPI types","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery/issues/89"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRBAY","labels":["codex","area:electron","priority:p2","type:refactor","cross-repo"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery","status":"Todo","title":"Migrate backend API client types to generated OpenAPI types"},{"content":{"body":"## Problem\n`electron/main.ts` owns too many architectural responsibilities: BrowserWindow/menu setup, protocol handling, DB IPC, backend API IPC, import/sync, backup, RAW/NEF preview, EXIF reads, export handling, config/diagnostics, and menu state.\n\n## Impact\nThe file is hard to review and test safely. Small changes to one feature increase the chance of regressions in unrelated IPC or app lifecycle behavior.\n\n## Proposed change\nExtract cohesive main-process services while preserving the renderer/preload boundary:\n\n- `apiIpcHandlers` for `api:*` handlers backed by `ApiService`.\n- `dbIpcHandlers` for `db:*` handlers backed by `electron/db.ts`.\n- `rawPreviewService` / `metadataService` for `nef:*` and image metadata reads.\n- `syncService` and `importService` for source scanning, import registration, and scheduling.\n- `backupService` for backup planning/runs.\n- `systemIpcHandlers` for config, diagnostics, external URL handling.\n\nDo this incrementally; do not change IPC names or preload contracts as part of the split unless covered by tests.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n- [ ] `electron/main.ts` is mostly app/window/menu composition and handler registration.\n- [ ] Existing IPC channel names remain stable.\n- [ ] Extracted modules have focused tests or preserve existing handler tests.\n- [ ] RAW/NEF preview, export orientation, sync/import, and backup behavior have no intentional behavior change.\n\n## Checks\n```bash\nnpx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit\nnpm run test:run -- electron/main.handlers.test.ts electron/nefExtractor.test.ts electron/backupSpace.test.ts electron/apiService.test.ts\n```","number":90,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-gallery","title":"Split Electron main process into focused service modules","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery/issues/90"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRBA0","labels":["codex","area:electron","priority:p2","type:refactor"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery","status":"Todo","title":"Split Electron main process into focused service modules"},{"content":{"body":"## Problem\nThe gallery depends on backend-owned pipeline terminology, phase codes, API schemas, and database read assumptions. Some checks exist, but they are not yet enough to prevent drift from reaching feature branches.\n\n## Evidence\n- Pipeline labels are duplicated in backend `frontend/src/types/api.ts` and gallery `src/constants/pipelineLabels.ts`.\n- Gallery docs say backend owns API/schema/terminology, but current contract checks already report drift.\n- Gallery direct DB reads depend on backend tables such as `images`, `image_phase_status`, `pipeline_phases`, normalized keywords, score columns, and `image_embeddings`.\n\n## Impact\nBackend changes can silently break gallery behavior unless both repos run the same contract/schema/terminology checks during review.\n\n## Proposed change\nAdd lightweight, deterministic gates:\n\n- Contract snapshot check against backend OpenAPI.\n- Generated type freshness check.\n- Pipeline terminology sync test for submit tokens, phase codes, and user labels.\n- DB compatibility smoke tests for gallery read models using a known schema fixture or backend-provided schema snapshot.\n- Docs/log update checklist for cross-repo changes.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n- [ ] `npm run contract:check` is part of the recommended/CI verification path.\n- [ ] Generated API types are checked for freshness.\n- [ ] A test fails when gallery pipeline labels/tokens drift from the backend source artifact or snapshot.\n- [ ] DB read-model assumptions are covered for images, folders, stacks, keywords, scores, and phase status.\n- [ ] Cross-repo change checklist is documented in gallery docs.\n\n## Checks\n```bash\nnpm run contract:check\nnpm run contract:validate\nnpm run check:type-sync\nnpm run test:run -- src/constants/pipelineLabels.test.ts electron/db.getImages.test.ts electron/db.getStacks.test.ts\n```","number":91,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-gallery","title":"Add cross-repo contract, terminology, and schema drift gates","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery/issues/91"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtRBBU","labels":["codex","area:db","area:electron","priority:p2","type:test","cross-repo"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery","status":"Todo","title":"Add navigation ΓÇö full keyboard support for gallery navigation"},{"content":{"body":"## Summary\r\n\r\n`images.scores_json` is still written on every score upsert as the full engine `result` blob (`json.dumps(result)`), while per-model numeric scores are already canonical in `image_model_scores` (migration 0016; legacy `score_*` columns dropped in 0023).\r\n\r\nSafe retirement requires moving blob-only data (LLM `subscores`, inference timings, `nef_metadata` paths) to structured storage, then following the same expand-contract pattern as [`docs/planning/database/IMAGE_EMBEDDING_COLUMN_DEPRECATION.md`](docs/planning/database/IMAGE_EMBEDDING_COLUMN_DEPRECATION.md).\r\n\r\n**Cross-repo:** minor gallery cleanup ΓÇö remove unused `scores_json` from `electron/db.ts` / types ([`image-scoring-gallery`](https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-gallery)).\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Current role (two layers)\r\n\r\n| Layer | Storage | Status |\r\n|-------|---------|--------|\r\n| Per-model scores | `image_model_scores` | **Canonical on Postgres** |\r\n| Full scoring run artifact | `images.scores_json` TEXT | **Still dual-written on every `upsert_image`** |\r\n\r\n```mermaid\r\nflowchart LR\r\n  Engine[MultiModelHost.run_all_models]\r\n  Upsert[db_legacy.upsert_image]\r\n  IMS[(image_model_scores)]\r\n  Blob[(images.scores_json)]\r\n  API[GET /api/images/id]\r\n  Engine --> Upsert\r\n  Upsert --> IMS\r\n  Upsert --> Blob\r\n  IMS --> API\r\n  Blob --> API\r\n```\r\n\r\n- **Write:** image_model_scores)","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/227"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgtspok","labels":["area:db","priority:p2","type:refactor","cross-repo"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Backlog","status":"Todo","title":"Deprecate images.scores_json (expand-contract after image_model_scores)"},{"content":{"body":"## Problem\n\nPer-image phase status can read `done` while the phase's data artifacts are absent ΓÇö a **phantom `done`**. Most recently: 5 folders / 942 images had `culling = done` with **zero `stack_id` and zero MobileNet embeddings** (clustering never actually ran). Root cause of that specific incident was a `SelectionRunner` RUNNING preset (fixed separately), but the *class* of bug is structural: the state machine validates transition **legality** but not data **postconditions**.\n\nThis is a re-regression of the March 2026 culling-no-stacks incident, so we need a structural guard, not just another point fix.\n\n## What already exists\n\n- `modules/phases.py` ΓÇö `PhaseStatus` enum + `_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS` graph + `is_transition_allowed`.\n- `modules/db_legacy.py::set_image_phase_status` ΓÇö choke point; already calls `is_transition_allowed` and honors `database.strict_phase_transitions`.\n- Postcondition predicates: `is_image_culling_complete`, `is_image_culling_similarity_artefacts_missing`, `is_image_scoring_complete`, ΓÇª (used by `phases_policy._phase_data_complete`).\n- `modules/workflow_healing.py` ΓÇö reactive reconciler that already detects the culling phantom (done + cull decision but no stack/embedding), with cooldown loop-breakers.\n- `modules/phase_work_claims.py` ΓÇö job-owned claims ledger (separate from `image_phase_status`).\n\n## Gaps that allow phantoms\n\n1. **No postcondition on terminal transitions** ΓÇö `RUNNING ΓåÆ DONE` is graph-legal even with zero stacks. *(keystone)*\n2. **RUNNING is not ownership/liveness-aware in policy** ΓÇö `phases_policy.explain_phase_run_decision` short-circuits on `already_running` before any owner/data check, so a stale/cross-owner RUNNING causes a skip that is then terminalized to DONE.\n3. **No single authority** ΓÇö `set_image_phase_status` is called from ~50 sites in 12 files; runners write DONE directly.\n4. **Two ledgers can disagree** ΓÇö `image_phase_status` vs `image_phase_work_claims`.\n\n## Plan (phased, flagged)\n\n- **Phase 1 ΓÇö Postcondition gate (keystone).** Gate terminal `DONE` writes through `set_image_phase_status`: when entering DONE, evaluate the phase completeness predicate; on failure write `FAILED` (`postcondition_failed:ΓÇª`), never DONE. Start with **CULLING**, behind config flag `phases.enforce_done_postconditions` (default off). Must treat legitimate singletons (clustered, dissimilar ΓåÆ 0 stacks but embeddings present) as complete by reusing `is_image_culling_similarity_artefacts_missing`, not a naive \"has a stack\" check.\n- **Phase 2 ΓÇö Ownership-aware RUNNING.** In `phases_policy`, before `already_running`: RUNNING owned by self or by a terminal/dead job ΓçÆ runnable (reclaim); only a live *other* job ΓçÆ skip. Never terminalize a lock-skip.\n- **Phase 3 ΓÇö Single authority.** Route all terminal writes through the guarded API; add a test/guard forbidding runners from writing DONE directly.\n- **Phase 4 ΓÇö Observability + immediate reconcile.** Surface `phantom_done_count` in pipeline stats/diagnostics; trigger `workflow_healing` on the job-completion hook for the just-processed scope (bounded by existing cooldowns). Optionally assert the `image_phase_status Γåö image_phase_work_claims` invariant.\n\n## Tests\n\n- Unit: DONE blocked when predicate false ΓåÆ lands FAILED; singleton-with-embedding passes (`tests/test_phases.py` / new `tests/test_phase_postcondition_gate.py`).\n- Ownership matrix (`tests/test_phase_work_claims.py`).\n- Regression for the original culling-no-stacks bug.\n- `pytest -m \"not gpu and not db and not ml\"` fast guard.\n\n## Rollback / flags\n\nGate behind `phases.enforce_done_postconditions` (off ΓåÆ soak ΓåÆ on). No schema change expected (`set_image_phase_status` already accepts `job_id`; verify it is persisted on the status row). Revert = flip flag.\n\n## Acceptance\n\n- With the flag on, a CULLING `done` write for an image with missing similarity artefacts is rejected and recorded as `failed`/needs-work ΓÇö phantom is unwritable.\n- Legitimate singleton folders are not looped by the gate or the healer.\n","number":230,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Postcondition-gated phase state machine to eliminate phantom phase statuses","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/230"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgu4rAg","linked pull requests":["https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/pull/237"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","status":"Done","title":"Postcondition-gated phase state machine to eliminate phantom phase statuses"},{"content":{"body":"@\n## Summary\n\nA **transient** RAW-conversion hiccup (a slow/failed `exiftool` subprocess under concurrent load) on a single image is recorded as a **terminal** scoring `failed` state. A single such row makes its folder perpetually \"needs work\" and, after the auto-drive loop-guard trips, the folder is permanently demoted to `loop_detected` ΓÇö i.e. **\"Drive to Complete\" silently refuses the folder** even though the underlying file is perfectly valid.\n\nObserved on folder `/mnt/d/Photos/Z8/180-600mm/2026/2026-05-25` (208 images): 207/208 fully processed; the lone holdout `DSC_6280.NEF` (image 190235) had scoring `failed` / `last_error=\"RAW Conversion Failed\"`. The file is **not corrupt** ΓÇö its embedded `JpgFromRaw` extracts to a valid 8256├ù5504 JPEG, and a manual re-score scored it 0.87 on the first retry.\n\n## Root cause (two compounding fragilities)\n\n**(A) Conversion layer ΓÇö `scripts/python/run_all_musiq_models.py`**\nFor Nikon Z8 HE* NEFs the only viable path is `_convert_with_exiftool` ΓåÆ `_exiftool_extract_preview_bytes`, which did `subprocess.run(..., timeout=10)` per tag and on any exception just moved on. If all tags transiently time out it returns `None` ΓåÆ `convert_raw_to_jpeg` returns `None` ΓåÆ `pipeline.py` sets `job.status=\"failed\"`, `error=\"RAW Conversion Failed\"`. **No retry.**\n\n**(B) Loop-guard layer ΓÇö `modules/runs_autodrive.py` + `modules/pipeline.py`**\n- A RAW-conversion failure in `PrepWorker` returned **before** the scoring `RUNNING` transition, so `attempt_count` stayed `0`. `scope_has_unattempted_phase_work()` (which keys on `attempt_count == 0`) therefore classified the image as \"never attempted\" forever ΓåÆ the folder was re-enqueued indefinitely (no-op churn).\n- The loop-guard bypass only forgives *never-attempted* work, so once the no-op completions accrued it tripped `loop_detected` and demoted the folder permanently, with no recovery path and no surfaced reason.\n\n## Fix (three phases ΓÇö implemented on branch `fix/transient-raw-conversion-loop-wedge`)\n\n1. **Conversion robustness:** retry transient `exiftool` failures (`raw_conversion.transient_retries`, default 2; `raw_conversion.exiftool_timeout_s`, default 20), while keeping a genuinely-absent tag terminal.\n2. **Per-image retry budget:** mark scoring `RUNNING` *before* RAW conversion so a conversion failure consumes the retry budget (`attempt_count` increments on retries) and the \"never attempted\" misclassification ends.\n3. **Stop the wedge:** new `db.scope_has_exhausted_phase_work()` / `get_scope_exhausted_failed_images()`; the loop-guard classifies a folder whose only remainder is retry-exhausted failures as **`failed_exhausted`** (naming the bad images, surfaced in `get_drive_diagnostics` anomalies) instead of opaque `loop_detected`. Gated by `runs_autodrive.treat_exhausted_failed_as_terminal` (default true); threshold from `scoring.max_image_retries` (default 3).\n\n## Tests\n- `tests/test_raw_conversion_retry.py` (ml): transient retry succeeds, retries bounded, absent tags not retried.\n- `tests/test_runs_autodrive.py`: `failed_exhausted` classification + image surfacing, kill-switch fallback, config threshold mapping.\n\n## Acceptance\n- A transient conversion failure no longer produces a permanent scoring `failed`.\n- A genuinely-failed image is bounded-retryable and, once exhausted, accounted as terminal so its folder is surfaced (`failed_exhausted`) rather than wedged in `loop_detected`.\n- No regression to loop-guard protection against a truly broken runner.\n@","number":243,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Transient RAW-conversion failure becomes terminal and wedges folder into auto-drive loop_detected","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/243"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgu-9Oo","labels":["bug","priority:p2","type:bug"],"linked pull requests":["https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/pull/244"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Review","status":"Done","title":"Transient RAW-conversion failure becomes terminal and wedges folder into auto-drive loop_detected"},{"assignees":["synthet"],"content":{"body":"## Summary\n\nScoring jobs interrupted **between** `ScoringWorker` (persists per-model rows to `image_model_scores`) and the `ResultWorker` finalize step (writes `images.score_general` via `upsert_image` + `set_image_phase_status(SCORING, DONE)`) leave images in a **phantom-scored** state:\n\n- per-model rows exist (ML inference ran and succeeded), **but**\n- `images.score_general` is NULL, **and**\n- the `scoring` phase row stays `not_started`/non-terminal.\n\nThis is a self-perpetuating wedge:\n\n- `is_image_scoring_complete()` returns **True** (it only checks for production per-model rows), so the JIT re-planner sees *no scoring work* and skips the phase, while\n- the folder bucketer reads `image_phase_status = not_started` and keeps re-bucketing the folder as `awaiting_scoring` ΓÇö **auto-drive re-enqueues forever and never finalizes anything.**\n\n`reconcile_phantom_complete_image_phases()` exists but only flips the phase row to `done`; it **never backfills the composite columns**, so the image would still show no `score_general` in the UI.\n\n## Impact (observed)\n\nFolder `D:\\Photos\\Z8\\180-600mm\\2026\\2026-05-24` (`/mnt/d/Photos/Z8/180-600mm/2026/2026-05-24`): **258 images** with per-model scores present but `score_general` NULL and `scoring` phase `not_started`. Dashboard shows the folder as perpetually incomplete; auto-drive cannot make progress on it.\n\n## Fix\n\nNew reconcile path that recomputes the composite **from the already-stored per-model rows** (no re-inference) and finalizes the phase:\n\n- `modules/phantom_score_finalize.py` ΓÇö `finalize_phantom_scores(scope_path|image_ids, dry_run, limit)`: selects scoring-*complete* (per-model rows present) but non-finalized images, recomputes `score_general`/`score_technical`/`score_aesthetic`/`rating`/`label` via `score_normalization.compute_all()` (only when `score_general` is NULL), then flips the `scoring` phase to `done`.\n- `scripts/maintenance/finalize_phantom_scores.py` ΓÇö CLI (`--scope` / `--all` / `--image-ids`, dry-run by default, `--apply` to write).\n- `tests/test_phantom_score_finalize.py` ΓÇö unit tests (no DB required).\n\nThis is the missing companion to `reconcile_phantom_complete_image_phases` ΓÇö it backfills the composite, not just the phase row.\n\n## Validation\n\nDry-run against the live 2026-05-24 folder:\n\n```\ncandidates:            258\ncomposites backfilled: 258\nphase finalized:       258\n```\n\nSample composites are sane (`score_general` 0.77-0.90); every sample showed `prev_phase_status: not_started` and `was_score_general_null: true`.\n\n## Follow-up (separate)\n\nThe *root cause* (interruption window in the scoring finalize path) is mitigated by treating the reconcile as idempotent recovery; hardening the worker handoff so the composite write + phase flip are atomic is tracked separately.\n\nRelated: #243 / PR #244 (transient RAW conversion + failed-image folder wedge).\n","number":245,"repository":"synthet/image-scoring-backend","title":"Phantom-scored images: per-model rows persisted but composite score_general never written, wedging folders in auto-drive","type":"Issue","url":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/issues/245"},"id":"PVTI_lAHOAFXgIs4BWC3czgu_zA0","labels":["bug"],"linked pull requests":["https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend/pull/246"],"repository":"https://github.com/synthet/image-scoring-backend","stage":"Review","status":"Done","title":"Phantom-scored images: per-model rows persisted but composite score_general never written, wedging folders in auto-drive"},{"content":{"body":"Trial [ai-memory](https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory) (Rust, MIT) as an **opt-in** capture/search sidecar for agent sessions.\n\n**Constraints (non-negotiable):**\n- Must feed candidates into `.agent-memory/raw-sessions/*.yaml` only.\n- Must **never** write `.agent-memory/memory.md` directly or bypass `scripts/agent-memory/promote_dream.py`.\n- Runs outside the application PostgreSQL/pgvector DB.\n\n**Why ai-memory:** markdown-git source of truth, MCP + lifecycle hooks across Claude/Cursor/Codex/Antigravity, zero-LLM mode.       1:#!/usr/bin/env python3
      2:"""
      3:Backfill ``images.bird_bbox`` for bird-tagged images that have never been scanned.
      4:
      5:Detector-only: runs YOLO ``synthet/bird-detect-v0`` (via ``BirdDetector``) without
      6:BioCLIP, so species keywords and embeddings are not rewritten. Writes a real box
      7:when a bird is found, or the ``BBOX_NOT_DETECTED`` sentinel (``{"detected": false}``)
      8:when the detector runs and finds nothing. Decode / detect failures write
      9:``{"detected": false, "error": "..."}`` so rows are not left ``NULL``. Only
      10:``NULL`` rows are selected on the next run.
      11:
      12:Usage (WSL, project root, per CLAUDE.md):
      13:  export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:$(pwd)/FirebirdLinux/Firebird-5.0.0.1306-0-linux-x64/opt/firebird/lib
      14:  source ~/.venvs/tf/bin/activate
      15:
      16:  # Inspect how many rows would be processed
      17:  python scripts/backfill_bird_bbox.py --dry-run
      18:
      19:  # Pilot one folder
      20:  python scripts/backfill_bird_bbox.py --folder "/path/to/folder"
      21:
      22:  # Full library, bird-tagged only (detach with setsid/nohup for long runs)
      23:  python scripts/backfill_bird_bbox.py --workers 4
      24:
      25:  # Every image with bird_bbox IS NULL (no birds* keyword filter)
      26:  python scripts/backfill_bird_bbox.py --all-null --workers 4
      27:"""
      28:from __future__ import annotations
      29:
      30:import argparse
      31:import logging
      32:import os
      33:import signal
      34:import sys
      35:import time
      36:from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
      37:from typing import Any, List, Optional, Tuple
      38:
      39:_PROJECT_ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
      40:if _PROJECT_ROOT not in sys.path:
      41:    sys.path.insert(0, _PROJECT_ROOT)
      42:
      43:logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")
      44:logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
      45:
      46:_SQL_MISSING_BBOX = """
      47:SELECT i.id, i.file_path, i.thumbnail_path, i.thumbnail_path_win
      48:FROM images i
      49:JOIN folders f ON i.folder_id = f.id
      50:WHERE i.bird_bbox IS NULL
      51:  AND EXISTS (
      52:    SELECT 1 FROM image_keywords ik
      53:    JOIN keywords_dim kd ON kd.keyword_id = ik.keyword_id
      54:    WHERE ik.image_id = i.id AND kd.keyword_norm LIKE ?
      55:  )
      56:  AND (? = '' OR f.path = ?)
      57:ORDER BY f.path, i.id
      58:"""
      59:
      60:#: Same as ``_SQL_MISSING_BBOX`` but no keyword gate — every ``bird_bbox IS NULL`` row.
      61:_SQL_MISSING_BBOX_ALL = """
      62:SELECT i.id, i.file_path, i.thumbnail_path, i.thumbnail_path_win
      63:FROM images i
      64:JOIN folders f ON i.folder_id = f.id
      65:WHERE i.bird_bbox IS NULL
      66:  AND (? = '' OR f.path = ?)
      67:ORDER BY f.path, i.id
      68:"""
      69:
      70:# Set by SIGINT handler; main loop finishes the in-flight chunk then stops.
      71:_stop_requested = False
      72:
      73:
      74:def _on_sigint(signum, frame) -> None:  # noqa: ARG001
      75:    global _stop_requested
      76:    if _stop_requested:
      77:        logger.warning("Second interrupt — exiting immediately.")
      78:        raise SystemExit(130)
      79:    _stop_requested = True
      80:    logger.warning("Interrupt received — finishing in-flight chunk then stopping.")
      81:
      82:
      83:def fetch_candidates(*, folder: str = "", limit: int = 0, all_null: bool = False) -> List[dict]:
      84:    """Return images with ``bird_bbox IS NULL``.
      85:
      86:    By default only bird-tagged rows (``keyword_norm LIKE '%birds%'``).
      87:    Pass ``all_null=True`` to include every null-bbox image (no keyword filter).
      88:    """
      89:    from modules import db
      90:
      91:    conn = db.get_db()
      92:    try:
      93:        c = conn.cursor()
      94:        folder_arg = (folder or "").strip()
      95:        if all_null:
      96:            c.execute(_SQL_MISSING_BBOX_ALL, (folder_arg, folder_arg))
      97:        else:
      98:            c.execute(_SQL_MISSING_BBOX, ("%birds%", folder_arg, folder_arg))
      99:        rows = c.fetchall()
      100:    finally:
      101:        conn.close()
      102:
      103:    out: List[dict] = []
      104:    for row in rows:
      105:        # Cursor may return tuple or dict-like depending on connector.
      106:        if hasattr(row, "keys"):
      107:            item = {
      108:                "id": int(row["id"]),
      109:                "file_path": row["file_path"],
      110:                "thumbnail_path": row.get("thumbnail_path") if hasattr(row, "get") else row["thumbnail_path"],
      111:                "thumbnail_path_win": (
      112:                    row.get("thumbnail_path_win") if hasattr(row, "get") else row["thumbnail_path_win"]
      113:                ),
      114:            }
      115:        else:
      116:            item = {
      117:                "id": int(row[0]),
      118:                "file_path": row[1],
      119:                "thumbnail_path": row[2] if len(row) > 2 else None,
      120:                "thumbnail_path_win": row[3] if len(row) > 3 else None,
      121:            }
      122:        out.append(item)
      123:        if limit > 0 and len(out) >= limit:
      124:            break
      125:    return out
      126:
      127:
      128:def _decode_oriented(row: dict) -> Tuple[int, Optional[Any], Optional[str]]:
      129:    """Decode + bake orientation. Returns (image_id, pil_image_or_None, error_or_None)."""
      130:    from modules.bird_species import _resolve_inference_path
      131:    from modules.thumbnails import bake_orientation, open_image_for_ml
      132:
      133:    image_id = int(row["id"])
      134:    file_path = row.get("file_path") or ""
      135:    try:
      136:        inference_path = _resolve_inference_path(row, file_path)
      137:        if not inference_path or not os.path.exists(inference_path):
      138:            return image_id, None, "file_missing"
      139:        img = open_image_for_ml(inference_path).convert("RGB")
      140:        try:
      141:            img = bake_orientation(img, inference_path)
      142:        except Exception as orient_err:  # noqa: BLE001 — orientation is best-effort
      143:            logger.debug("bake_orientation failed for image_id=%s: %s", image_id, orient_err)
      144:        return image_id, img, None
      145:    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — continue batch
      146:        return image_id, None, f"decode_error: {exc}"
      147:
      148:
      149:def apply_detection_result(
      150:    image_id: int,
      151:    box: Optional[dict],
      152:    *,
      153:    dry_run: bool,
      154:    update_fn=None,
      155:    error: Optional[str] = None,
      156:) -> str:
      157:    """Persist a box, not-detected sentinel, or scan-failed sentinel.
      158:
      159:    Returns ``'detected'|'not_detected'|'scan_failed'|'write_error'``.
      160:    """
      161:    from modules.bird_detection import bird_bbox_payload
      162:
      163:    if update_fn is None:
      164:        from modules import db
      165:
      166:        update_fn = db.update_image_bird_bbox
      167:
      168:    payload = bird_bbox_payload(box, error=error)
      169:    if error:
      170:        outcome = "scan_failed"
      171:    elif box is not None:
      172:        outcome = "detected"
      173:    else:
      174:        outcome = "not_detected"
      175:    if dry_run:
      176:        return outcome
      177:    if update_fn(image_id, payload):
      178:        return outcome
      179:    return "write_error"
      180:
      181:
      182:def process_batch(
      183:    rows: List[dict],
      184:    *,
      185:    detector,
      186:    dry_run: bool,
      187:    workers: int,
      188:    progress_every: int,
      189:    decode_fn=_decode_oriented,
      190:    update_fn=None,
      191:) -> dict:
      192:    """Decode in a pool, run YOLO serially, write boxes/sentinels. Returns counters."""
      193:    detected = 0
      194:    not_detected = 0
      195:    skipped = 0
      196:    errors = 0
      197:    written = 0
      198:    t0 = time.monotonic()
      199:    total = len(rows)
      200:    chunk_size = max(workers * 4, workers)
      201:    processed = 0
      202:
      203:    for start in range(0, total, chunk_size):
      204:        if _stop_requested:
      205:            break
      206:        chunk = rows[start : start + chunk_size]
      207:        decoded: List[Tuple[int, Optional[Any], Optional[str]]] = []
      208:
      209:        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
      210:            futures = [pool.submit(decode_fn, row) for row in chunk]
      211:            for fut in as_completed(futures):
      212:                decoded.append(fut.result())
      213:
      214:        by_id = {image_id: (img, err) for image_id, img, err in decoded}
      215:
      216:        for row in chunk:
      217:            image_id = int(row["id"])
      218:            img, err = by_id.get(image_id, (None, "missing_decode_result"))
      219:            processed += 1
      220:
      221:            if err or img is None:
      222:                skipped += 1
      223:                skip_reason = err or "decode_error"
      224:                if err and err != "file_missing":
      225:                    errors += 1
      226:                    logger.warning("Skip image_id=%s: %s", image_id, err)
      227:                outcome = apply_detection_result(
      228:                    image_id,
      229:                    None,
      230:                    dry_run=dry_run,
      231:                    update_fn=update_fn,
      232:                    error=skip_reason,
      233:                )
      234:                if outcome == "scan_failed" and not dry_run:
      235:                    written += 1
      236:                elif outcome == "write_error":
      237:                    errors += 1
      238:                    logger.error("Failed to write bird_bbox for image_id=%s", image_id)
      239:                continue
      240:
      241:            try:
      242:                box = detector.detect_best_box(img)
      243:            except Exception as det_err:  # noqa: BLE001
      244:                errors += 1
      245:                logger.warning("Detect failed image_id=%s: %s", image_id, det_err)
      246:                outcome = apply_detection_result(
      247:                    image_id,
      248:                    None,
      249:                    dry_run=dry_run,
      250:                    update_fn=update_fn,
      251:                    error=f"detect_error: {det_err}",
      252:                )
      253:                if outcome == "scan_failed" and not dry_run:
      254:                    written += 1
      255:                elif outcome == "write_error":
      256:                    errors += 1
      257:                    logger.error("Failed to write bird_bbox for image_id=%s", image_id)
      258:                continue
      259:            finally:
      260:                try:
      261:                    img.close()
      262:                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
      263:                    pass
      264:
      265:            outcome = apply_detection_result(
      266:                image_id, box, dry_run=dry_run, update_fn=update_fn
      267:            )
      268:            if outcome == "detected":
      269:                detected += 1
      270:                if not dry_run:
      271:                    written += 1
      272:            elif outcome == "not_detected":
      273:                not_detected += 1
      274:                if not dry_run:
      275:                    written += 1
      276:            else:
      277:                errors += 1
      278:                logger.error("Failed to write bird_bbox for image_id=%s", image_id)
      279:
      280:            if progress_every > 0 and processed % progress_every == 0:
      281:                elapsed = max(time.monotonic() - t0, 1e-6)
      282:                rate = processed / elapsed
      283:                remaining = max(total - processed, 0)
      284:                eta = remaining / rate if rate > 0 else 0
      285:                logger.info(
      286:                    "Progress %s/%s (%.1f img/s, ETA %.0fs) — detected=%s none=%s skipped=%s",
      287:                    processed,
      288:                    total,
      289:                    rate,
      290:                    eta,
      291:                    detected,
      292:                    not_detected,
      293:                    skipped,
      294:                )

      """DB-backed per-image phase work claims to prevent duplicate processing across runs."""
      
      from __future__ import annotations
      
      import logging
      from typing import Any
      
      from modules import db
      
      logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
      
      
      def claim_image_phases(
          job_id: int,
          phase_code: str,
          image_ids: list[int],
      ) -> dict[str, Any]:
          """Claim ``image_ids`` for ``phase_code`` on ``job_id``. Skip IDs already claimed elsewhere."""
          phase = (phase_code or "").strip().lower()
          claimed: list[int] = []
          skipped: list[int] = []
          if not phase or not image_ids:
              return {"claimed": claimed, "skipped_already_claimed": skipped}
      
          unique_ids: list[int] = []
          seen: set[int] = set()
          for raw in image_ids:
              try:
                  iid = int(raw)
              except (TypeError, ValueError):
                  continue
              if iid in seen:
                  continue
              seen.add(iid)
              unique_ids.append(iid)
      
          if not unique_ids:
              return {"claimed": claimed, "skipped_already_claimed": skipped}
      
          conn = db.get_connector()
          placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(unique_ids))
          rows = conn.query(
              f"""
              SELECT image_id, job_id
              FROM image_phase_work_claims
              WHERE phase_code = ?
                AND status IN ('queued', 'running')
                AND image_id IN ({placeholders})
              """,
              tuple([phase] + unique_ids),
          )
          blocked: dict[int, int] = {}
          for r in rows or []:
              try:
                  blocked[int(r["image_id"])] = int(r["job_id"])
              except (TypeError, ValueError, KeyError):
                  continue
      
          for iid in unique_ids:
              owner = blocked.get(iid)
              if owner is not None and owner != int(job_id):
                  skipped.append(iid)
                  continue
              existing = conn.query_one(
                  """
                  SELECT job_id FROM image_phase_work_claims
                  WHERE image_id = ? AND phase_code = ? AND status IN ('queued', 'running')
                  """,
                  (iid, phase),
              )
              if existing:
                  if int(existing["job_id"]) == int(job_id):
                      claimed.append(iid)
                  else:
                      skipped.append(iid)
                  continue
              try:
                  conn.execute(
                      """
                      INSERT INTO image_phase_work_claims (job_id, image_id, phase_code, status)
                      VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'queued')
                      """,
                      (int(job_id), iid, phase),
                  )
                  claimed.append(iid)
              except Exception:
                  logger.debug(
                      "claim_image_phases failed job_id=%s image_id=%s phase=%s",
                      job_id,
                      iid,
                      phase,
                      exc_info=True,
                  )
                  skipped.append(iid)
      
          return {"claimed": claimed, "skipped_already_claimed": skipped}
      
      
      def mark_claims_running(job_id: int, phase_code: str, image_ids: list[int] | None = None) -> None:
          phase = (phase_code or "").strip().lower()
          if not phase:
              return
          params: list = [int(job_id), phase]
          extra = ""
          if image_ids:
              placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(image_ids))
              extra = f" AND image_id IN ({placeholders})"
              params.extend(int(i) for i in image_ids)
          db.get_connector().execute(
              f"""
              UPDATE image_phase_work_claims
              SET status = 'running'
              WHERE job_id = ? AND phase_code = ? AND status = 'queued'{extra}
              """,
              tuple(params),
          )
      
      
      _TERMINAL_JOB_STATUSES = (
          "interrupted",
          "failed",
          "completed",
          "canceled",
          "cancelled",
      )
      
      
      def reconcile_orphan_work_claims(*, limit_jobs: int = 500) -> dict:
          """Release open claims owned by jobs already in a terminal status.
      
          Closes the gap when ``recover_running_jobs`` or other paths mark jobs
          interrupted without calling ``release_claims_for_job`` (e.g. crash recovery
          before the release hook existed). Idempotent: only touches queued/running
          claims on terminal jobs.
      
          Returns ``{"released_rows": int, "job_ids": list[int]}``.
          """
          try:
              lim = max(1, int(limit_jobs))
          except (TypeError, ValueError):
              lim = 500
          placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(_TERMINAL_JOB_STATUSES))
          try:
              rows = db.get_connector().query(
                  f"""
                  SELECT DISTINCT c.job_id AS job_id
                  FROM image_phase_work_claims c
                  JOIN jobs j ON j.id = c.job_id
                  WHERE c.status IN ('queued', 'running')
                    AND j.status IN ({placeholders})
                  ORDER BY c.job_id DESC
                  FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
                  """,
                  tuple(_TERMINAL_JOB_STATUSES) + (lim,),
              )
          except Exception:
              logger.exception("reconcile_orphan_work_claims: scan failed")
              return {"released_rows": 0, "job_ids": []}
      
          job_ids = [int(r["job_id"]) for r in rows or [] if r and r.get("job_id") is not None]
          released_total = 0
          for jid in job_ids:
              try:
                  released_total += int(release_claims_for_job(jid) or 0)
              except Exception:
                  logger.debug(
                      "reconcile_orphan_work_claims: release failed for job_id=%s",
                      jid,
                      exc_info=True,
                  )
          if released_total:
              logger.info(
                  "reconcile_orphan_work_claims: released %s claim row(s) across %s job(s)",
                  released_total,
                  len(job_ids),
              )
          return {"released_rows": released_total, "job_ids": job_ids}
      
      
      def reconcile_orphan_work_claims_all(
          *,
          limit_jobs: int = 500,
          max_passes: int = 20,
      ) -> dict:
          """Run ``reconcile_orphan_work_claims`` until no rows are released or ``max_passes``.
      
          Handles installations with more than ``limit_jobs`` distinct terminal jobs holding
          open claims (each single pass is capped). Returns accumulated
          ``released_rows``, ``job_ids``, and ``passes``.
          """
          try:
              max_p = max(1, int(max_passes))
          except (TypeError, ValueError):
              max_p = 20
          total_released = 0
          all_job_ids: list[int] = []
          passes = 0
          for _ in range(max_p):
              passes += 1
              summary = reconcile_orphan_work_claims(limit_jobs=limit_jobs)
              released = int(summary.get("released_rows") or 0)
              total_released += released
              all_job_ids.extend(summary.get("job_ids") or [])
              if released == 0:
                  break
          if passes > 1 and total_released:
              logger.info(
                  "reconcile_orphan_work_claims_all: %s pass(es), %s claim row(s) released",
                  passes,
                  total_released,
              )
          return {"released_rows": total_released, "job_ids": all_job_ids, "passes": passes}
      
      
      def release_claims_for_job(job_id: int) -> int:
          """Release open claims for a job. Returns number of rows updated."""
          row = db.get_connector().query_one(
              """
              SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM image_phase_work_claims
              WHERE job_id = ? AND status IN ('queued', 'running')
              """,
              (int(job_id),),
          )
          count = int((row or {}).get("cnt") or 0)
          if count:
              db.get_connector().execute(
                  """
                  UPDATE image_phase_work_claims
                  SET status = 'released', released_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                  WHERE job_id = ? AND status IN ('queued', 'running')
                  """,
                  (int(job_id),),
              )
          return count
      
      
      def count_claimed_by_other(job_id: int, phase_code: str, image_ids: list[int]) -> int:
          phase = (phase_code or "").strip().lower()
          if not phase or not image_ids:
              return 0
          placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(image_ids))
          row = db.get_connector().query_one(
              f"""
              SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM image_phase_work_claims
              WHERE phase_code = ?
                AND status IN ('queued', 'running')
                AND job_id != ?
                AND image_id IN ({placeholders})
              """,
              tuple([phase, int(job_id)] + [int(i) for i in image_ids]),
          )
          return int((row or {}).get("cnt") or 0)

      _LOG_SCHEDULED_CAP = 15
      
      
      def _format_skip_summary(skipped: Sequence[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
          counts = Counter(str(item.get("reason") or "unknown") for item in skipped)
          return ", ".join(f"{reason}={count}" for reason, count in sorted(counts.items()))
      
      
      def _log_scheduled_runs(scheduled: Sequence[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
          if not scheduled:
              return
          logger.info("runs_autodrive: queued %d folder run(s)", len(scheduled))
          for entry in scheduled[:_LOG_SCHEDULED_CAP]:
              phases = entry.get("phases") or []
              phase_label = ",".join(str(p) for p in phases) if phases else "?"
              logger.info(
                  "runs_autodrive:   job %s — %s [%s] phases=%s",
                  entry.get("job_id"),
                  entry.get("folder_path"),
                  entry.get("bucket"),
                  phase_label,
              )
          overflow = len(scheduled) - _LOG_SCHEDULED_CAP
          if overflow > 0:
              logger.info("runs_autodrive:   … and %d more queued folder(s)", overflow)
      
      
      def _log_drive_tick_result(
          *,
          tick_reason: str,
          summary: dict[str, Any],
          stop_reason: str | None = None,
      ) -> None:
          health = summary.get("health") or {}
          msg = (
              "runs_autodrive: drive tick reason=%s outstanding=%s scheduled=%s skipped=%s "
              "candidates=%s in_flight=%s schedulable=%s blocked=%s idle_no_progress=%s"
          )
          args: list[Any] = [
              tick_reason,
              summary.get("total_outstanding"),
              summary.get("scheduled"),
              summary.get("skipped"),
              summary.get("candidates"),
              health.get("in_flight_folders"),
              health.get("schedulable_folders"),
              health.get("blocked_folders"),
              get_drive_state().get("idle_no_progress_ticks"),
          ]
          if stop_reason:
              msg += " stop=%s"
              args.append(stop_reason)
          logger.info(msg, *args)
      
      
      DEFAULT_TARGET_PHASES: tuple[str, ...] = tuple(p.value for p in PhaseCode)
      ACTIVE_JOB_STATUSES = {"pending", "queued", "running", "paused"}
      ACTIVE_PHASE_STATUSES = {"queued", "running", "paused", "cancel_requested", "restarting"}
      COMPLETE_PHASE_STATUSES = {"done", "skipped"}
      # Terminal failures count toward loop guard; completed runs are forgiven only when the folder
      # made measurable progress since the last completed run (see _recent_auto_attempt_counts).
      _LOOP_GUARD_TERMINAL_STATUSES = frozenset({
          "failed",
          "canceled",
          "cancelled",
          "interrupted",
      })
      # Completed auto-drive job statuses — re-queued only when progress advanced, otherwise they
      # count toward max_repeats so a stuck folder cannot be enqueued forever.
      _LOOP_GUARD_COMPLETED_STATUSES = frozenset({"completed", "done", "success", "succeeded"})
      # Minimum overall_percent gain (0–100 scale) that counts as "the folder advanced" between passes.
      _PROGRESS_EPS = 0.0
      AUTODRIVE_CANDIDATE_SCAN_CAP = 500
      BIRD_BACKLOG_QUOTA_THRESHOLD = 50
      
      
      def _as_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
          try:
              if value is None:
                  return default
              return int(value)
          except (TypeError, ValueError):
              try:
                  return int(float(value))
              except (TypeError, ValueError):
                  return default
      
      
      def _as_float(value: Any, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
          try:
              if value is None:
                  return default
              return float(value)
          except (TypeError, ValueError):
              return default
      
      
      def _status(value: Any) -> str:
          return str(value or "not_started").strip().lower() or "not_started"
      
      
      def _local_path(raw: str) -> str:
          path = str(raw or "").strip()
          if not path:
              return ""
          try:
              return utils.convert_path_to_local(path) or path
          except Exception:
              return path
      
      
      def _path_key(raw: str) -> str:
          local = _local_path(raw)
          if not local:
              return ""
          return os.path.normpath(local).replace("\\", "/").rstrip("/").lower()
      
      
      def _path_matches(path_key: str, root_key: str) -> bool:
          if not root_key:
              return True
          return path_key == root_key or path_key.startswith(root_key + "/")
      
      
      def _path_intersects_active(path_key: str, active_keys: Iterable[str]) -> bool:
          for active in active_keys:
              if not active:
                  continue
              if path_key == active or path_key.startswith(active + "/"):
                  return True
          return False
      
      
      def _is_leaf_folder_for_autodrive(path_key: str, all_path_keys: Iterable[str]) -> bool:
          if not path_key:
              return False
          for other in all_path_keys:
              if other and other != path_key and other.startswith(path_key + "/"):
                  return False
          return True
      
      
      def _subtree_total_from_summary(summary: Sequence[dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
          totals = [_as_int(row.get("total_count")) for row in (summary or [])]
          return max(totals) if totals else 0
      
      
      def _reconcile_stale_ips_for_drive() -> None:
          try:
              db.reconcile_stale_running_phases_for_terminal_jobs(limit=500)
          except Exception:
              logger.debug("runs_autodrive: reconcile terminal job IPS failed", exc_info=True)
          try:
              db.reconcile_stale_running_image_phases(limit=500)
          except Exception:
              logger.debug("runs_autodrive: reconcile stale running IPS failed", exc_info=True)
          # Phantom-complete reconcile: images already scored / tagged whose IPS row never
          # advanced to ``done`` make a folder look ``awaiting_scoring`` / ``awaiting_keywords``
          # while the planner correctly finds no work → nothing_to_queue / loop_detected churn.
          # Marking them done lets the drive reach genuinely-incomplete folders.
          #
          # ``culling`` is deliberately excluded (issue #340). Its work product is a *folder-level*
          # grouping decision, so per-image data shape (a ``cull_decision``, an embedding) never
          # proves clustering actually ran. Including it marked 672 never-clustered images ``done``
          # in one 23-second sweep, which hid whole folders from the drive permanently — the
          # folder rollup read culling complete and the bucketer advanced past it forever.
          try:
              db.reconcile_phantom_complete_image_phases(
                  ("indexing", "metadata", "scoring", "keywords"),
                  limit=5000,
              )
          except Exception:
              logger.debug("runs_autodrive: reconcile phantom-complete IPS failed", exc_info=True)
          try:
              db.reset_false_complete_metadata_phases(limit=500)
          except Exception:
              logger.debug("runs_autodrive: reset false-complete metadata IPS failed", exc_info=True)
          # Heal rows poisoned by the pre-#340 sweep: culling ``done``/``skipped`` on images that
          # provably never clustered (no stack and no default-space embedding). Resetting them to
          # ``not_started`` marks the folder aggregate dirty in-transaction, so the drive re-buckets
          # the folder to ``awaiting_culling`` by itself on the next tick.
          try:
              db.reset_false_complete_culling_phases(limit=500)
          except Exception:
              logger.debug("runs_autodrive: reset false-complete culling IPS failed", exc_info=True)
          try:
              db.reset_retryable_stale_phase_failures(limit=500)
          except Exception:
              logger.debug("runs_autodrive: reset retryable stale phase failures failed", exc_info=True)
      
      
      def _autodrive_config_bool(key: str, *, default: bool = True) -> bool:
          try:
              from modules.config import get_config_value
      
              return bool(get_config_value(key, default=default))
          except Exception:
              return default
      
      
      def _has_active_maintenance_job() -> bool:
          try:
              rows = db.get_jobs(
                  limit=30,
                  offset=0,
                  status_filter=("queued", "running", "pending", "paused", "restarting"),
              ) or []
          except Exception:
              return False
          for row in rows:
              if (row.get("job_type") or "").strip().lower() != "maintenance":
                  continue
              status = (row.get("status") or "").strip().lower()
              if status in ("queued", "running", "pending", "paused", "restarting"):
                  return True
          return False
      
      
      def _enqueue_maintenance_action(action: str, *, limit: int, tool_id: str) -> int | None:
          from modules.maintenance_job_display import (
              build_default_maintenance_description,
              maintenance_job_input_path,
          )
          from modules.run_manifest import (
              REASON_SOURCE_MAINTENANCE,
              attach_run_reason,
              build_maintenance_summary,
          )
      
          queue_payload: dict[str, Any] = {"action": action, "limit": limit}
          if action == "heal_thumbnails":
              queue_payload["repair_limit"] = 1000
              queue_payload["regen_limit"] = min(limit, 500)
          queue_payload = augment_queue_payload_for_audit(queue_payload, trigger="api", tool_id=tool_id)
          queue_payload = attach_run_reason(
              queue_payload,
              source=REASON_SOURCE_MAINTENANCE,
              summary=build_maintenance_summary(action=action),
              trigger="api",
              tool_id=tool_id,
              criteria={"action": action, "limit": limit, "source": "auto_drive_self_heal"},
          )
          job_id, _ = db.enqueue_job(
              maintenance_job_input_path(action, queue_payload),
              None,
              job_type="maintenance",
              queue_payload=queue_payload,
              description=build_default_maintenance_description(action, queue_payload),
          )
          return int(job_id) if job_id else None
      
      
      def _maybe_enqueue_drive_self_heal_maintenance(summary: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
          """Enqueue bounded maintenance when library-wide asset gaps remain."""
          out: dict[str, Any] = {"enqueued": []}
          if not _autodrive_config_bool("auto_drive.self_heal_thumbnails", default=True) and not _autodrive_config_bool(
              "auto_drive.self_heal_exif", default=True
          ):
              return out
          if _has_active_maintenance_job():
              out["skipped"] = "maintenance_already_running"
              return out
          try:
              gaps = db.count_metadata_asset_gaps()
          except Exception:
              logger.debug("runs_autodrive: count_metadata_asset_gaps failed", exc_info=True)
              return out
          out["gaps"] = gaps
          if summary is not None:
              summary["asset_gaps"] = gaps
          if _autodrive_config_bool("auto_drive.self_heal_thumbnails", default=True):
              thumb_n = int(gaps.get("thumbnail_gap_count") or 0)
              if thumb_n > 0:
                  job_id = _enqueue_maintenance_action(
                      "heal_thumbnails",
                      limit=min(thumb_n, 500),
                      tool_id="auto_drive_heal_thumbnails",
                  )
                  if job_id:
                      out["enqueued"].append({"action": "heal_thumbnails", "job_id": job_id})
          if _autodrive_config_bool("auto_drive.self_heal_exif", default=True):
              exif_n = int(gaps.get("exif_date_gap_count") or 0)
              if exif_n > 0 and not out["enqueued"]:
                  job_id = _enqueue_maintenance_action(
                      "backfill_exif",
                      limit=min(exif_n, 10000),
                      tool_id="auto_drive_backfill_exif",
                  )
                  if job_id:
                      out["enqueued"].append({"action": "backfill_exif", "job_id": job_id})
          return out
      
      
      _POST_AUDIT_FOLLOWUP_PHASE_ORDER: tuple[str, ...] = (
          PhaseCode.INDEXING.value,
          PhaseCode.METADATA.value,
          PhaseCode.SCORING.value,
          PhaseCode.CULLING.value,
          PhaseCode.KEYWORDS.value,
          PhaseCode.BIRD_SPECIES.value,
      )
      
      
      def _first_post_audit_stage_with_work(
          stage_queues: dict[str, Any],
      ) -> tuple[str, int] | None:
          """Return (phase_code, remaining_count) for the earliest pipeline stage with audit work."""
          for code in _POST_AUDIT_FOLLOWUP_PHASE_ORDER:
              info = stage_queues.get(code)
              if not isinstance(info, dict):
                  continue
              remaining = int(info.get("total") or 0)
              if remaining > 0:
                  return code, remaining
          return None
      
      
      def maybe_schedule_post_audit_followup(
          job_id: int,
          payload: dict[str, Any],
          post_run_audit: dict[str, Any],
      ) -> int | None:
          """Re-queue auto-drive work when post-run audit still shows residual stage gaps."""
          if payload.get("tool_id") != "runs_auto_drive":
              return None
          if not _autodrive_config_bool("auto_drive.post_audit_followup", default=True):
              return None
          # Gate on the whole-pipeline signal, not the (phase-scoped) badge ``status``: a single-phase
          # run can have a clean badge while downstream phases still need work. ``pipeline_status`` is
          # the authoritative full-pipeline flag; fall back to ``status`` for audits written before it
          # existed. ``stage_queues`` remains the full per-phase plan in both cases.
          pipeline_status = post_run_audit.get("pipeline_status") or post_run_audit.get("status")
          if pipeline_status != "issues_remaining":
              return None
          stage_queues = post_run_audit.get("stage_queues") or {}
          first = _first_post_audit_stage_with_work(stage_queues)
          if not first:
              return None
          first_phase, remaining = first
          scope_paths = payload.get("scope_paths") or []
          if not scope_paths:
              ip = payload.get("input_path")
              if ip:
                  scope_paths = [ip]
          if not scope_paths:
              return None
          resolved = str(scope_paths[0]).strip()
          if not resolved:
              return None
          target = sort_phase_value_strings(
              [str(p) for p in (payload.get("target_phases") or payload.get("phases") or list(DEFAULT_TARGET_PHASES))]
          )
          try:
              start_idx = target.index(first_phase)
          except ValueError:
              start_idx = 0
          next_phases = target[start_idx:]
          # Post-audit follow-ups bypass the drive-loop max_repeats gate; without a local
          # bound they re-enqueue forever when a phase completes as a no-op (e.g. culling
          # aborting on NULL score_general while phase rows stay not_started).
          plan_key = str(payload.get("auto_drive_plan_key") or _plan_key(resolved, next_phases) or "")
          max_repeats = max(1, min(_as_int(_DRIVE_STATE.get("max_repeats"), 2), 20))
          try:
              from modules.config import get_config_value
      
              max_repeats = max(
                  1,
                  min(_as_int(get_config_value("auto_drive.max_repeats", default=max_repeats), max_repeats), 20),
              )
          except Exception:
              pass
          if plan_key:
              meta = (
                  _recent_auto_attempt_counts(
                      [plan_key],
                      since_job_id=_drive_session_since_job_id(),
                  ).get(plan_key)
                  or {}
              )
              last_status = _status(meta.get("last_status"))
              if last_status in ACTIVE_JOB_STATUSES:
                  logger.info(
                      "runs_autodrive: post_audit follow-up skipped job_id=%s scope=%s reason=plan_key_in_flight plan_key=%s",
                      job_id,
                      resolved,
                      plan_key,
                  )
                  return None
              completed_attempts = _as_int(meta.get("completed_attempts"))
              failure_attempts = _as_int(meta.get("failure_attempts"))
              if (completed_attempts + failure_attempts) >= max_repeats:
                  logger.info(
                      "runs_autodrive: post_audit follow-up skipped job_id=%s scope=%s "
                      "reason=loop_detected attempts=%s max_repeats=%s plan_key=%s",
                      job_id,
                      resolved,
                      completed_attempts + failure_attempts,
                      max_repeats,
                      plan_key,
                  )
                  return None
          try:
              follow_id, _, err = _enqueue_auto_bucket(
                  {
                      "path": resolved,
                      "bucket": f"awaiting_{first_phase}",
                      "next_phases": next_phases,
                      "overall_percent": payload.get("auto_drive_overall_percent"),
                      "folder_created_at": None,
                      "is_newly_imported": False,
                  },
                  generate_captions=bool(payload.get("generate_captions", True)),
                  resolved=resolved,
                  phase_values=list(next_phases),
              )
          except Exception:
              logger.exception(
                  "runs_autodrive: post_audit follow-up enqueue failed job_id=%s scope=%s",
                  job_id,
                  resolved,
              )
              return None
          if err:
              logger.info(
                  "runs_autodrive: post_audit follow-up skipped job_id=%s scope=%s reason=%s",
                  job_id,
                  resolved,
                  err,
              )
              return None
          logger.info(
              "runs_autodrive: post_audit follow-up queued %s job %s (%d remaining) for parent job %s (%s)",
              first_phase,
              follow_id,
              remaining,
              job_id,
              resolved,
          )
          return follow_id
      
      
      AUTODRIVE_DIRTY_REFRESH_LIMIT = 100
      # Default for GET /runs/folder-buckets so dirty aggregates refresh instead of synthetic not_started.
      FOLDER_BUCKETS_DIRTY_REFRESH_DEFAULT = AUTODRIVE_DIRTY_REFRESH_LIMIT
      
      _DEFAULT_NEW_FOLDER_DAYS = 7
      
      
      def _autodrive_prioritize_new_folders() -> bool:
          try:
              from modules.config import get_config_value
      
              return bool(get_config_value("auto_drive.prioritize_new_folders", default=True))
          except Exception:
              return True
      
      
      def _autodrive_new_folder_days() -> int:
          try:
              from modules.config import get_config_value
      
              return max(1, _as_int(get_config_value("auto_drive.new_folder_days", default=_DEFAULT_NEW_FOLDER_DAYS), _DEFAULT_NEW_FOLDER_DAYS))
          except Exception:
              return _DEFAULT_NEW_FOLDER_DAYS
      
      
      def _new_folder_cutoff_ts(*, days: int | None = None) -> float:
          window = _autodrive_new_folder_days() if days is None else max(1, int(days))
          cutoff = datetime.datetime.now() - datetime.timedelta(days=window)
          return cutoff.timestamp()
      
      
      def _folder_created_at_sort_ts(created_at: Any) -> float:
          if created_at is None:
              return 0.0
          if isinstance(created_at, (int, float)):
              return float(created_at)
          if isinstance(created_at, datetime.datetime):
              dt = created_at
              if dt.tzinfo is None:
                  return dt.timestamp()
              return dt.timestamp()
          raw = str(created_at).strip()
